tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /slob dpon chen po spyod 'chang dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo badz+ra satwa ya/ nyi gzhon bye ba phrag brgyas mi dpogs pa'i/ /ye shes gzi 'od rgyas pas 'gro mun sel/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa'i rba rlabs rab g.yos pas/ /bdud dang mu stegs zil gnon gang de rgyal/ /gang las ngo mtshar gtam gyi phul/ /rnam pa sna tshogs grags de las/ yid ches khungs dang ldan pa dag /mdo tsam mchog tu gsal bar sdeb/ /'dir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa'i rjes su mi lo chen po stong dang lnga brgyar nye ba na/ grub pa'i dbang phyug slob dpon nag po spyod pa zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ngo*/ /de yang slob dpon klu sgrub kyis dpal ldan 'bras spungs nas spyan drangs pa'i dpal mgon po'i rgyud brgyad yod pa las/ gzhan bdun gyi snying po nag po chen po mngon par 'byung ba zhes pa/ mgon po phyag gnyis pa dang*/ bzhi pa dang*/ drug pa dang*/ brgyad pa dang*/ bcu gnyis pa dang*/ bcu drug pa'i dkyil 'khor ston pa/ kha ba can gyi phyogs 'dir rwa lo tsā ba chos rab kyis bsgyur nges pa rgya dpe can de las de ltar yul u ru bi shar yang mtshungs par nges pa'o/ /der skyes bu brtson 'grus chen po dang ldan zhing sbyor ba la brtson pa rā ma ṇa'i bka'i 'jug pa dang mtshungs pa/ sde tshan dang po'i dang po dbyangs yig dang pos brgyan pa/ bdun pa'i bzhi pa cung zad na la zhon pa'i ming can rnal 'byor dbang po skyes bu'i mchog gcig po 'dis ral gri la sogs pa'i dngos grub chen po brgyad thob par 'gyur ro/ /dzam bu'i gling du ma byung zhing 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de'i slob ma rnal 'byor pa drug gis lus kyi dngos po spangs pa'i phyag rgya chen po thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhais gsungs pa dang*/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud phyi ma 'gyur rnying las/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang rus rgyan cang te chang snod thogs pa nag po'i ming can 'byung bar 'gyur/

/zhes lung bstan pa ste/ lung dang po'i don ni der zhes pas gang du 'khrungs pa'i yul dang*/ brtson 'grus dang ldan zhing sbyor ba la brtson pa ni/ rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa rgya cher spyod pa'i don dang*/ rā ma ṇa'i bka'i 'jug pa dang mthun pa ni lang ka'i gling la sogs par gdug pa can rnams tshar gcod pa'i don dang*/ sde tshan dang po'i dang po ka yig /bdun pa'i bzhi pa ha yig /cung zad na la zhon pa ni hā yig de nyid na yig dang brtsegs pa ste/ de ltar na kah+na zhes pa mtshan bstan pa yin no/ /nag po'i skad dod mang du yod kyang*/ kah+na zhes pa slob dpon 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa'i mtshan te/ kah+na tsar+ya'am/ 'phral skad du/ kah+ni pa zhes grags so/ /ral gri la sogs pa'i dngos grub brgyad ces pas/ thun mong gi grub pa brgyad la mnga' brnyes pa ste gzhan la sbyin nus pa'o/ /ma byung zhing 'byung bar mi 'gyur zhes pa ni/ slob dpon 'di lta bu gzhan dus gsum khegs par bsngags pa ste/ de yang slob dpon 'dis 'gro ba'i don spyad pa na/ gsung gdams ngag dngos kyi khyab pa dang*/ ma yin kyang de'i mig rkyen la brten pa'i grong khyer chen po bcu gsum tsam gyi skyes pa bud med khye'u bu mo tshun chod 'jig rten gyi bya ba spangs te rnal 'byor pho mo 'ba' zhig tu gyur pas grong khyer de dag re zhig stongs so/ /de dag kun kyang rab kyis dngos grub mchog dang*/ 'bring gis thun mong gi dngos grub dang*/ tha ma rnams kyis kyang phra mo'i las ma grub pa med skad de/ thams cad kyang ting nge 'dzin thob pa sha stag go /de'i slob ma drug ces bya ba ni/ skyes pa'i rten can slob dpon nyid kyi drung du bsnyen cing bzhugs pa'i 'khor rnams kyi nang nas slob dpon nyid sku bzhugs pa'i dus su phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob pa ni drug ste/ e ya la pa dang*/ ma hi la pa dang*/

bha dra pa dang*/ dha ma pa dang*/ dhu ma pa dang*/ tshim bu pa rnams so/ /lus kyi dngos po spangs pa zhes bya ba ni 'chi srid kyis lus bor ba'i don ma yin te/ rnam par smin pa'i lus 'di gnas gyur nas/ 'ja' lus rdo rje'i skur song ba'o/ /lung phyi ma'i don ni/ kha ṭ+wāṃ zhes phyag mtshan dang rgyan bstan pa ni/ slob dpon 'dis spros bcas kyi spyod pa gtso bor mdzad pas/ phal cher lha'i chas su zhugs par ston/ nag po zhes pa'i mtshan yang bstan to/ /kṛṣ+ṇa ā tsar+ya zhes pa yang slob dpon 'di'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs yin mod kyi/ kṛṣ+ṇa pa'i mtshan can gzhan yang shin tu mang ngo*/ /slob dpon 'di la kah+nā tsar+ya ste slob dpon nag po dang*/ kṛṣ+ṇā tsar+ya pa yang slob dpon nag po'o/ /kah+na kṛṣ+ṇa dang thung ngu'i mthar tsar+ya pa sbyar na/ kah+na tsar+ya pa kṛṣ+ṇa tsar+ya pa ste nag po spyod pa ba zhes dang*/ yang tsar+yā tsar+ya pa ste slob dpon spyod pa ba dang*/ de bzhin du tsar+ya badz+ra te spyod pa'i rdo rje dang*/ ā tsar+ya tsar+ya dha ri pa ste slob dpon spyod 'chang dbang po la sogs par grags so/ /de yang 'phags yul shar phyogs gau ra'i rgyal khams kyi nang tshan o ru bi sha zhes bya ba/ bha d+ga la dang cung zad nye ba'i phyogs shig yin/ yul der mi rigs chen po bzhi las bram ze'i rigs su sku 'khrungs so/ /bod kyi lo rgyus rnying pa 'ga' na/ rje rigs su 'chad pa yod kyang*/ slob dpon nyid kyi do ha las/ reg gin reg gin 'gro ste bram ze'i bu/ zhes gsungs pa/ de la mtshon don rdzogs rim la sbyar ba'i bshad pa yod kyang*/ mtshon byed brda de yang kun rdzob dngos po dang 'grig dgos pas/ slob dpon bram ze'i rigs yin par lung des grub/ rgya gar na sngon nas da lta'i bar du yang slob dpon 'di phyi nang thams cad la grags che zhing*/ thams cad mgrin gcig par bram ze'i rigs yin par kun la grags so/

/yang slob dpon 'di bod du ma byung rgya gar du byung ba yin la/ 'di'i rigs la cha rgyus yod du rung ba'i yul rgya gar du kun la mthun par grags pa de bkag nas/ cha rgyus med pa'i rgyal khams bod lta bur de dang 'gal bar smra ba dag la 'di ni bden te/ smra ba po de skyes bu bzang po yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes smra ba ni legs pa ma yin te/ g.yem ma mu cor gyi rgyal lo zhes pa'i don dang mtshungs par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /de nas chung ngu'i dus nas blo rno zhing sgra dang*/ sman dpyad dang*/ bzo'i gnas thams cad la mkhas par byas/ der sngon gyi las 'phro sad pas/ ye shes kyi rnal 'byor ma du mas zhal mngon sum du bstan/ de nas rim gyis yul dbus ma ga dha'i cha shas/ dpal na len+d+ra zhes bya ba/ paṇ+ḍi ta lnga brgya gnas shing chos grwa shin tu dar bas der byon te dge slong mdzad cing lo mang du bzhugs nas sde snod gsum dang*/ rgyud sde bzhi'i thos bsam gyis rgyud byang bar mdzad cing*/ sngags dang bsam gtan yang ci rigs pa grub par gyur to/ /der dben pa bstan te/ bsgom zhing bzhugs pa'i skabs shig /grub pa'i rnal 'byor ma chen mo lcam la k+ṣ+mī ka ras zhal bstan rgyud byin gyis brlabs ting nge 'dzin khyad par can brnyes so/ /der rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma 'ga' zhig gis nam mkha' nas gsung gi snang ba phyung ste/ byang phyogs kyi grong khyer dza lan dha ra na/ bla ma dza lan+dha ri pa zhes pa yod kyi/ khyod kyis de bsten na 'dod pa'i dngos grub tu 'gyur ro/ /zhes grags pas bdag nyid gcig pu yul dza lan dha rar bzhud do/ /der grub thob dza lan dha ri pa dang mjal/ slob dpon de ni rang byung gdod nas grub pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug ches che ba yin cing*/ sku lus kyi bkod pa yang cig car mang du ston pas yul tha dad sna tshogs na sku du mas dus gcig tu bzhugs shing*/

slob ma dngos grub thob pa'ang mang mod kyi/ yul der dus skabs gdul bya 'dul ba'i dbang gis/ dmangs rigs kyi rnal 'byor pa rtag tu slong mo la spyod pa phal pa'i tshul 'dzin pa cig yod skad/ der mkhas pa'i nga rgyal spangs nas zhabs la gus pas btud de rjes su gzung bar gsol ba btab pas/ skal ba dang ldan par mkhyen nas/ yang dag par dbang bskur zhing gdams pa dang rjes su gdams pa mtha' dag bstsal to/ /de nas dza lan dha ra'i yul de'i phyogs gcig tu rdo rje theg pa'i don bsgom zhing bzhugs pa'i tshe/ lan cig 'dod na rtsig pa la yang thogs med du 'byon nus pa dang*/ brag ri la yang zhabs bying zhing bzhed na thal byung du bzhud nus pa dang*/ nam ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pa'i tshe bdag nyid dpal he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor du gsal bar gzigs shing*/ lha de rnams kyis dri lan mdzad pa'i tshul gyis slob dpon nyid kyi the tshom gcod pa dang*/ bstod pa dang rdo rje glu nam blangs pa na/ sa g.yo ba'am/ me tog gi char 'bab pa'am/ sgra 'byin pa'am/ 'od snang bar byed pa 'byung ngo*/ /der spyod pa bya ba'i dus yin nam dgongs pa na/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma 'ga' zhig mngon sum du byon te bzlog par mdzad do/ /yang bsgom zhing bzhugs pa na/ phyugs 'tsho ba'i byis pa 'ga' zhig rtse mo rtse zhing song ba'i shul du shing a sho ka la ral gri'i gzugs byas pa 'ga' zhig dag bor te 'dug pa la/ gcig phyag tu bsnams te byon/ shing drung zhig tu de mdun du bzhag ste ting nge 'dzin bsgom zhing bzhugs pa na/ ral gri de las me rang 'bar bar gyur te/ de phyag tu thogs pa na nam mkha' la 'phags shing mngon shes dang ldan par gyur to/ /der dgongs pa bla ma'am lhag pa'i lhas bkas ma gnang bar dngos grub kyi rol pa mi bya'o dgongs te/ re zhig mi snang bar sbas so/ /yang lan cig lam du bzhud pa na brag ri'i khongs na grub pa'i dngul chu'i gter yod pa gzigs shing*/

de'i sgo yang rang bye ba dang*/ yang sa gzhi la rin po che'i gter yod pa gzigs shing sgo yang bye ba dang*/ yang sgrub pa po gcig gis nags kyi mthongs shig tu mi gzhan med do snyam dben pa'i 'du shes kyis ril bu lcags gsum gyis dkris pa zhig bcos te/ ljon shing cig gi rtsa bar sbas so/ /de nags gseb na gnas pa'i g.yo can zhig rtswa'i gseb na yib nas bsdad pas mthong*/ sgrub pa po de grong khyer du song ba na/ g.yo can des ril bu de brkus te song ba na/ gzhan la btsongs kyang ma brin/ rang la mkho med nas/ 'di su dang phrad pa la sbyin no snyam tsa na/ slob dpon 'di lam gyi gzhi mdo na bsgom zhing bzhugs pa dang phrad de/ sku mdun du bor te song ngo*/ /de la spyan gyis gzigs shing thugs brtad pa na/ chu tshod gcig tsam na sgra dang 'od zer byung ngo*/ /de zhal du bcug pas lha dang gnod sbyin gyi gnas rnams kyang gzigs shing*/ bzhed na skad cig la der 'byon pa'i nus pa thob/ 'on kyang snga ma bzhin du dgongs nas/ re zhig mi snang bar sbas so/ /yang lan cig lam du bzhud pa na sa 'og gi 'jig rten du 'gro ba'i dpal gyi sgor rang bye bar gzigs nas/ lam de la zhugs nas yud tsam zhig gis sa 'og gi 'jig rten rnams gzigs shing nyams 'og tu chud par byas/ slar rang nyid kyi sgrub gnas su 'khor ro/ /de dag la sogs pa thun mong gi dngos grub mang po ched du ma sgrubs kyang rang gi ngang gis grub par gyur to/ /der dgongs pa da ni nges par spyod pa bya ba'i dus la bab po snyam nas/ bla ma dza lan dha ri pa la snang ba zhus pas/ kye ma mig 'phrul mkhan khyod de tsam ngo mtshar ci che/ da lta khyod kyis spyod pa bya bar mi nus kyi/ de bas 'di nas byang phyogs na dpag tshad lnga brgya tsam na/ yul pre ta pu ri yod/ de na mkha' 'gro ma skal ba bzang mo zhes bya ba yod/ de gsang rgyud mtha' dag 'dzin pa yin pas/

de'i lag nas gsang ba kun bsdus pa zhes kyang bya/ kha sbyor thig le zhes bya ba'i rgyud yod pas/ de spyan drongs la shogasems can mang po la phan par 'gyur/ de yang khyod kyis gsol ba btab pa tsam gyis mi ster gyi/ ngas len du btang ba yin byas na ster bar 'gyur ro gsung*/ de nas de'i nang par nag po spyod pa byang phyogs su bzhud pas/ nyi ma de nyid kyi thun tha ma la bab pa tsam na/ bye ma'i thang skya bo zhig gi dbus gad pa'i khugs shig na/ khyim ngan pa re hrul 'dra ba zhig 'dug /de dang nye bar phyin pa na/ bud med ngan ma zhig chu len du byung ba dang 'phrad nas/ de nub gnas g.yar dgos byas pas/ de lan cig nang du song nas slar yang 'bod du byung*/ de nas slob dpon khyim gyi nang du byon tsa na/ de na bud med gzhan zhig 'dug pa dang*/ des rnal 'byor pa gang du 'gro zer/ slob dpon gyis sngar gyi gtam bshad pas/ de na re/ yul pre ta pu ri yang 'di ka yin/ mkha' 'gro ma skal ba bzang mo yang nga yin zer/ slob dpon gyi dgongs pa la/ de rang min las che dgongs te/ de'i nang par byang phyogs su gshegs pas/ nyi ma nub la khad tsa na sngar gyis de kar 'khor/ de'i yang nang par bzhud pas kyang sngar bzhin da nang 'ongs pa'i gnas de nyid du 'khor/ de nas slob dpon gyis mkha' 'gro ma de la phyag 'tshal te/ khyed kyi phyag na dpal sam+bu ṭa kha sbyor thig le'i rgyud yod pa 'dug pa/ slob dpon dza lan+dha ri pas rgyud de len par bdag btang ba yin pas/ rgyud de'i gleg bam yang bstsal bar zhu/ gdams pa dang rjes su gdams pa yang gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ gnas khang de yang khang bzang rgyan gyis brgyan par gyur/ bud med de yang gzi brjid 'od du 'bar ba rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ gser gyi khri la 'dug pa cig tu gyur nas/ sam+bu ṭa'i rgyud kyi glegs bam ni gtad/ dza lan+dha ri pa ni 'di mi 'dod de 'ong*/

'on kyang skal ba dang ldan pa 'ga'i don gyis shig ces gnang ba bstsal lo/ /'dir bod rnying pa rnams las mkha' 'gro ma skal ba bzang mo yin ces rwa ba dang lo chung ba'i phyogs rnams zer ba legs par mngon te rgya gzhung 'ga' rer bla ma brgyud pa la de ltar bgrangs pas so/ /de rdo rje phag mo dang*/ bdag med ma'i sprul par 'dod pa sna tshogs yod de don la mi 'gal lo/ /mar do lugs kyi lo rgyus na/ mkha' 'gro ma 'gro ba bzang mo yin zer ba yod de/ 'gro bzang mo zhes pa de ni mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba ye shes kyi mtshan gyi rnam grangs yin par grags so/ /de la'ang 'gal ba med do/ /sngon bod du byung pa'i 'di skabs kyi lo rgyus rnams na/ dbang bskur zhing gdams pa dang rjes su gdams pa mtha' dag bstsal ces pa ni/ so so'i skye bo'i slob dpon gyis slob ma phal pa cig la byed pa bzhin du/ rdul tshon bzhengs/ dbang rdzas bsags/ chog 'don btang*/ nyin mo bsgrubs mtshan mo bskur/ deb cha sgrog pa dang*/ gzhung gi 'bru bshad 'dzug 'khrid byed pa dang*/ 'dzin chos btang ba ma yin gyi/ slob dpon nag po skal ldan gyi gang zag de la/ sprul pa'i sku ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma des/ dgongs pa brtad de thugs rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa tsam gyis/ skad cig de la ye shes khyad par can brnyes/ rgyud don ma lus pa thugs su chud/ bka'i snang ba bstsal pa tsam gyis sems can gyi don rgya cher spyod pa'i nus pa thob pa de ka dbang bskur ba dang*/ gdams ngag rjes gdams bla na med pa yin no/ /'dis mtshon pa'i sngon gyi grub thob chen po rnams kyi rnam thar na/ gcig gis gcig la gdams tshul yod pa rnams/ phal cher de bzhin yin la/ rang cag bod 'di na go ba 'di tsam la yang mtha' gnyis gang rung gcig tu lhung bar snang ste/ blun po rnams dang*/ blun po'i rjes 'brang mkhas 'dod yod pa phal cher zhig ni/

grub thob rnams la de ltar yin pa'i go ba rab rib cig shar ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas/ da lta'i bla ma dang*/ slob ma phal ba lam sna tsam yang ma zin pa sgab sgob rnams la yang grub thob gyi rigs 'gre 'gran 'dod byas te/ dbang bskur rgyud bshad man ngag thams cad rtsa bas bcad/ po ti mgo la 'jog pa dang*/ dgongs pa brtad pas chog pa sogs mi shes pa dang*/ ma lcogs pa la bzang bzang mo dang dpa' dpa' mo byed do/ /de rigs la bla mas ma bshad/ slob mas ma go dpon slob gnyis kar gyis ci yang mi shes pa la/ shes pa dag byed pa las mi yong bar 'dug pa 'di chad pa'i mtha' yin/ yang sngags gzhung dang*/ cho ga la rtsis su byed pa rnams kyang*/ da lta las dang po pa gang byed pa'i rgyas bkab ste/ 'phags pa dang*/ grub thob dang*/ sgrub pa po mchog rnams la'ang byed pa ni/ sgrigs bkod dam dam mo dang mkhas 'dod byas pas ti thug tu song ste/ 'di ka la ltos pa'i rtag pa'i mtha' yin no/ /des na las dang po pa la brgyud pa khungs la thug pa'i chos bka' ma chad pa cig dgos/ cho ga lag len byang la ma nor ba zhig dgos/ bsnyen sgrub la sogs pa tshad du phyin pa cig dgos/ rang rang gi gzhung bshad the tshom chod nges/ blo rtse brtad 'tsham yong nges shig dgos man ngag rnams lag len du btab na thebs res pa cig dgos so/ /grub pa thob pa rnams kyi spyod yul ni gzhan yin pas/ de 'dri'i nges khrigs med kyang*/ de la log lta dang the tshom mi bya/ gus pas gsol ba thob cigad ni dkyus la 'jug par bya ste/ de nas slob dpon gyis tshur lam yang yud tsam zhig gis bgrod nas/ rgyud kyi glegs bam mkha' 'gro'i phyag nas spyan drangs pa de slob dpon la phul bas/ khyod kyis mkha' 'gro ma de la rtog dpyod med par gsol ba btab na/ de nyid du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur ba yin pas de'i don du btang ba yin kyang*/

rnam par rtog pas bsgribs kyi/ da nga la glegs bam gyi dgos pa med pas khyod nyid khyer zhig ces bor nas/ gzhan la'ang ston cig /'di sngon nyid ngas shes gsung*/ rgyud de'i tshig don mtha' dag skad cig de la bla mas gsungs so/ /de nas kyang bsgom zhing bzhugs pa na/ mi ring pa'i skabs shig 'byung po gzhan gyis mi thub pa dang*/ gser gyi phug na gnas pa'i gnod sbyin mo la sogs pa/ gnod sbyin mo mang po dag 'ongs nas/ rang rang gi sngags dang*/ rgyud kyi sbyor ba dang dngos grub dag 'bul bar byed do/ /'on kyang rig pa'i brtul zhugs spyad nas/ phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob par bzhed pa yin pas/ re zhig de dag bor te bzhugs so/ /de rjes yang lan cig bla ma dza lan+dha ri pa'i gsung las/ khyod dpal o rgyan gyi gnas su song la/ phyag rgya drug po 'di rnams la rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i byin rlabs zhus la myur du shog cig /de yang o rgyan gyi gnas de na/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma mang po yod pa rnams kyi nang na/ gzhan rnams dang rnam pa mi 'dra ba zhig yod pa de la zhus gsung*/ mi rus kyi rgyan drug phra mo ngan don zhig slob dpon la gtad do/ /yul dza lan+dha ra nas o rgyan gyi bar la dpag tshad brgya dang nyi shu yod skad/ de yang nyin zhag gcig gam gnyis kyis bcad nas/ o rgyan gyi gnas der byon zhing*/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dpag tu med pa dang mjal/ de rnams kyi cho 'phrul ya mtshan can mang po yang gzigs/ lan cig mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i bkod pa rgya chen po'i grwar zhugs te/ lhan cig tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dga' ston nyams su myong bar mdzad pa na/ kun gyi gral gsham na gnas pa'i mkha' 'gro ma zhig bzhin mi sdug pa/ mig shel mig tu 'dug pa/ so mi mnyam pa/ lus kha dog ngan zhing rtsub pa/ gos hrul ba zhig 'dug go /slob dpon gyis lung bstan pa'i mkha' 'gro ni de yin par mkhyen nas/

bdag slob dpon dza lan+dha ri pas btang ba yin/ rus rgyan 'di byin gyis rlob par zhu zhus pas/ des kyang sngags btab ste re re bzhin mdud rgya re byas te/ slob dpon nag po pa la tshur gtad do/ /de nas slob dpon tshur byon te/ lam dben pa zhig tu thugs tseg tseg byed de/ mkha' 'gro ma'i mdud rgya bkrol te/ rus rgyan de sku la gsol bas/ srid pa gsum mthong ba'i mngon shes skyes/ sa 'og sa steng sa bla gsum la thogs med du 'gro ba'i nus pa thob bo/ /yang rgyan rnams bkrol te snod du bsnams nas/ 'di 'dra gda' zhes slob dpon la phul bas/ mkha' 'gro'i rgya de bshig tu mi rung pa la/ zhes cung zad ma mnyes pa'i tshul mdzad skad de/ don la mkha' 'gro'i rgya ma bshig par bla ma la phul na/ rus rgyan de bla mas de ma thag gnang bar 'gyur zhing*/ de sku la gsol ba tsam gyis mchog brnyes par 'gyur rgyu yin par snang ngo*/ /de nas gnas der ci rigs par bzhugs te/ sngar mkha' 'gro ma skal ba bzang mo dang*/ bla ma dza lan+dha ri pas bka'i gnang pa yod pa la brten nas/ skal ldan gyi slob ma ci rigs ci rigs tsam gyis 'dus pa la/ rdo rje theg pa'i chos dag bstan to/ /slob ma de rnams kyis kyang ting nge 'dzin re la bstan pa thob cing*/ nus pa sna re yang byung ngo*/ /de nas slob dpon nyid kyis/ ri lu mig sman ral gri dang*/ /rkang mgyogs bcud len gnod sbyin mo/ /ro langs dang ni sa 'og ste/ /grub pa rnam pa brgyad yin no/ /zhes pa ltar gyi rdzas kyi dngos grub de dag /sgrub pa'i cho ga cung zad tsam res tshegs med par grub pa mang du mdzad nas/ slob ma de dag rnams la'ang skal ba dang 'tshams par dngos grub re re byin/ de rnams kyis kyang cho ga lhag ma sgrubs pas dngos grub phra mo sna re thob ste/ de'i tshe slob ma bdun cu rtsa gnyis yod skad la/ sum cu so bdun rnal 'byor ma yin/

rnal 'byor pa sum cu so lnga yod skad/ de nas skabs shig na slob dpon rang nyid kyis drod tshad gzigs te/ brag de'u cig la lta stangs byas pas zhig pa dang*/ gso ba'i lta stangs mdzad pas 'byor ro/ /yang shing n+ya gro dha'i sdong po la lta stangs mdzad pas bskams shing tshig /yang gso pa'i lta stangs mdzad pas sngar bzhin sos so/ /de nas gzhan thams cad kyang ci 'dod 'ong bar 'dug nas/ da ni nges par rig pa rtul zhugs kyi spyod pa bya'o dgongs nas/ bla ma dza lan+dha ri pa'i drung du da ni bdag gis spyod pa la 'jug par nus pas/ bla mas cis kyang bkas gnang bar zhu/ bdag gi 'khor 'di kun gyis kyang nus pa sna re thob lags pa/ 'di dag kyang khrid du rung ba'i gnang ba stsol zhes zhus pas/ bla ma na re/ da dung khyod la nus pa med pa 'dra/ yod na ston cig gsung*/ stag la rengs pa'i lta stangs mdzad pas de ma thag shing bzhin du rengs/ ljon shing 'bras bus rgyan pa la ltung ba'i lta stangs mdzad pas/ 'bras bu thams cad sa la lhags/ ri dwags kṛṣ+ṇa sa ra la dgug pa'i lta stangs mdzad pas/ skad cig la drung du rgyugs te zhabs la ldag par byed/ yul gan+dha ra'i rgyal po la dbang du byed pa'i lta stangs mdzad pas rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa der 'ongs te zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas/ slob dpon gyi bzhed pa ji lta bu bka' stsol cig ces zhu'o/ /gzhan yang gong bu dgug pa dang*/ rkang pa dgug pa sogs mang du bstan to/ /gan+dha ri'i rgyal po ma gtogs gzhan rnams la bla mas da ni khrol zhig ces gsung pa la/ slob dpon spyod pa pa nyid kyis 'grol bar brtsams pa la/ 'ga' zhig cung zad tsam re ma gtogs dgrol ma nus/ de yang bla ma dza lan+dha ri pas zil gyis mnan pa yin/ de rjes khong nyid kyis slar gsos nas/ khyed kyis da dung spyod pa sngas/ gso nus pa dgos pa yin gsung*/ de nas kyang cung zhig bzhugs shing bsgoms nas skabs der ljon shing la 'gags te dpyangs pa'i mi ro mtshan ldan zhig la/

lta stangs mdzad pas 'gags thag chad/ sa la lhung pa la thugs brtad pas ro langs chen po phebs te/ slob dpon gyi drung na 'dug cing g.yog byed do/ /skye bo phal gyis lan re tsam mthong*/ phal cher mi mthong ngo*/ /der snga ma las kyang nus pa cher 'phel bas/ 'khor rnams kyi nang du dril bsgrags te/ kho bo ni rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa spyod pas/ khyed nus pa thob pa rnams kyang nga dang lhan cig rgyu bar bya'o gsung*/ de rjes bla ma'i drung du phyag 'tshal nas/ sngar ni bla ma'i nus pas zil gyis mnan pa lags/ yong nas bdag gis tshar bcad rjes gzung gnyis ka nus pa lags pas/ nges par gnang ba zhu zhes zhus pa la/ slob dpon dza lan+dha ri pas/ mkha' 'gro mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i rus pa'i rgyan drug de yang*/ slob dpon nag po la gnang nas/ 'o na da khyod rig pa'i brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa gyis shig /'on kyang yul de wi ko ṭir ma 'gro zhig /lhag ma dur khrod brgyad dang*/ yul chen gzhan thams cad du ci bder rgyur bar gyis zhes bkas gnang ngo*/ /de nas brtsams te slob dpon spyod pa pa ni lam gyi spyod yul du rgyu ba'i tshe/ gdugs bdun ni 'dzin pa med pa rang 'khor/ ḍā ma ru bdun ni 'khrol ba po med par rang 'khrol/ res 'ga' ni zhabs khri gang gi sa la mi regs par bzhud/ res 'ga' ni ro langs me tog gi 'phreng ba can la chibs te 'byon/ lta stangs brgyad dam bcu'i sgo nas nyin re bzhin sems can mang po'i don mdzad do/ /dus lan 'ga' ni gdugs bdun bdun brgyar 'phel ba dang*/ ḍā ma ru bdun yang bdun brgyar 'gro ba dang*/ 'khor tshogs rnams kyang rang rang gi cho 'phrul dang bcas te bzhud pa dang bzhugs par yang mdzad do/ /de nas yul mā la pa dang mahā raṣ+ta dang*/ ka ta li k+ṣe tra ste chu shing gi zhing zhes pa rnams su yang ci rigs par bzhugs shing sems can gyi don mdzad/ yul der grub thob go rak+ṣa dang mjal te/

de na re/ khyod dza lan+dha ri'i slob ma yin na/ dza lan+dha ri pa ni/ shar phyogs kyi rgyal po go bi tsan+d+ras sa dong du sbas nas lo bcu gnyis kyang lon na zhes 'phya ba ltar byung bas/ slob dpon spyod pa 'khor stong bzhi brgya dang bcas pa shar phyogs su byon nas/ rgyal po go bi tsan+d+ra'i pho brang gi sgo drung du bzhugs so/ /der grong khyer gyi rta dang glang po che rnams rtswa mi za/ bu chung rnams kyang ma'i nu zho mi 'thung*/ rol mo thams cad la yang sgra ma byung ngo*/ /der rnal 'byor pas nus pa bstan par shes nas/ rgyal po de spyom chung ngus phyir phyung*/ slob dpon gyi zhabs la phyag byas te/ nang bar slob dpon 'khor bcas bdag gi khyim du 'byon par zhu gdan non par bgyid zhus pas/ nga la 'khor stong dang bzhi brgya yod pas/ khyod kyis tshim par bya mi nus gsung ba la/ ngas dmag mi 'bum phrag mang po la rtag tu zan sbyor na/ slob dpon 'khor bcas la ci'i phyir mi nus zhus/ slob dpon na re/ 'o na dang por nga'i slob ma gnyis tshims par gyis shig de tshims na nged gzhan rnams kyang rim pas 'ong ngo gsung*/ de nas de'i sang nyin snga dro mi stong dang bzhi brgya tshims par nus pa'i kha zas khyad par rnam pa mang po dag sbyar ba na/ rnal 'byor pa ma hi la dang*/ bha da la gnyis der byung ngo*/ /der de gnyis kyi ku ba'i lhung bzed du kha zas de dag yongs su rdzogs par blug kyang*/ snod kyang ma khengs la/ rnal 'byor pa de gnyis kyis thams cad gsol kyang da dung ma tshim mo zhes gsungs/ der nus pa'i rtags bstan par shes nas/ rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis slob dpon 'khor bcas rnams la mchod pa du mas mchod/ zhabs la gtugs te rjes su bzung bar zhus pas/ spros pa dang bcas pa'i dbang bskur zhing*/ gdams pa dang*/ rjes su gdams pa yang bstsal nas/ mthar rdza'i bum pa stong pa lag par gtad pa'i brda thabs kyis/

de kho na nyid 'chi ba med pa'i lam bstsal pa na/ rgyal po na re/ 'di ni sngar gzhan la thos zin no zhus/ su la thos gsungs/ ha ḍi ba la thos zhus pas/ de ni grub thob dza lan+dha ri pa yin na/ khyod kyis sdig bsags pas khyod la 'chi ba med pa'i lam ga la 'ong*/ 'khor bcas thal bar 'gyur grang gsungs/ der rgyal po 'gyod pas gdungs shing shin tu skrag la/ spyod pa ba'i slob ma rnams kyis ni dong gi sa dang nyal nyil rnams bsal nas/ aṣ+ta dhā tu la rgyal po'i gzugs brnyan gsum byas te/ re re bzhin grub thob dza lan+dha ra'i zhabs la gtugs pa na/ smod pa mdzad pas thal bar song*/ de mthong pas rgyal po ches 'jigs shing skrag nas/ dran med du rgyal zhing 'gyel lo/ /de ltar bsdigs pas rgyal po'i sems kyi dri ma byang*/ phyis bzod pa gsol du bcug nas rjes su gzung*/ slob dpon grub brnyes dpon slob rnam pa gnyis kar gyis gdams pa bstan pas/ dus gzhan mi ring pa zhig na rgyal pos kyang grub pa thob bo/ /de skabs bhaṅga lar tshul de ltar bstan mod/ yul dza lan+dha ra na ni sngon bzhin bzhugs pa kho na'o/ /de nas slob dpon spyod pa ba/ yul shar lho o ḍi bi sha dang*/ de dang nye ba ka ling ka'i yul du ci rigs par bzhugs nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad/ de nas sing ga la'i gling du gshegs par bzhed nas/ slob dpon rang nyid rgya mtsho'i steng du zhabs bzhag nas mi bying bar bzhud do/ /'khor nus pa thob pa rnams kyang rang rang gi 'phrul gyis 'gro ste/ kha cig ni rgya mtsho la lpags gdan bting nas 'gro/ kha cig ni rgya mtshor mkhar ba bsgyur pa la rkang pa bzhag nas 'gro/ kha cig ni byi'u zul byed cing 'gro kha cig ni nya'i steng du 'dug cing 'gro kha cig ni chu la ma reg par bar snang la 'gro ba sogs sna tshogs pa dag go /ka ling ka nas sing gha la'i bar la rgya mtsho kha zheng dpag tshad brgya phrag du ma yod pa/

chu tshod gcig gam gnyis kyi bar la spyad nas sing gha lar phebs so/ /der rgyal po ra tha ba la zhes bya ba yod de/ de 'khor dang bcas pa cho 'phrul gyi bkod pa de mthong bas lhag par dad de/ zhabs la phyag 'tshal zhing*/ mchod pa rgya chen pos yun ring du mchod do/ /gling de na de'i sngon du gsang sngags gyi theg pa ma dar pa las/ skabs der rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa dar bar mdzad/ grub pa thob pa yang mang du byung ngo*/ /rgyal po dang*/ blon po dang*/ khyim bdag /tshong dpon la sogs pas lha khang gsar du bzhengs pa mang po dag la byin rlabs rab tu gnas pa mdzad do/ /de nas rgyal po la yang dbang bskur zhing*/ gsang sngags kyi lha khang yang bzhengs/ de la kṛṣ+ṇa bi ha ra zer/ da lta'i bar du byin rlabs che/ rang gi skal ba dang 'tshams par zhag bdun nas zla ba gcig gi bar du sa the btsugs nas gsol ba 'debs nus na/ long bar gyur pas kyang mig skyon med pa thob pa dang*/ bud med mo gsham yang dus ldan mar gnas 'gyur ba sogs yod do/ /gling der de sngon du tshangs pa'i srin po zhes bya ba'i gdon gyis 'tshe ba rtag tu yong zhing*/ de yang nyin bar gyi dus 'tshub ma sgor rlung gi rnam par 'ongs nas/ byis pa pho mo dang*/ rta dang glang po dang phyugs sogs la des skor ba tsam gyis skad cig la mang po 'chi bar 'gyur ba dang*/ mtshan mo'i dus na khyim skyod cing 'od 'byin pas mi phyugs dag gsod par byed pa dang*/ skabs 'gar bram ze dang btsun pa'i gzugs su bsgyur nas mi'i srog 'phrog pa dag yod de/ der slob dpon gyis de dag bskrad cing dam la bzhag pas gnod pa de da lta'i bar du rgyun chad cing*/ yang mkha' 'gro srin mo'i rigs kyi gnod pa sna tshogs pa 'byung ba yang de phyin chad med do/ /de nas gling ḍa mi ḍo zhes bya ba gdug pa'i mkha' 'gro ma mang pos gang ba'i gnas shig na/ mkha' 'gro'i rigs kyi srin mo chen mo/

bi shwa ru bi te/ sna tshogs gzugs can ma zhes pa 'khor srin mo lnga brgya dang bcas mi mo'i gzugs su bsgyur te gnas la/ de rnams kyi sprul pas nyin re bzhin du/ 'dzam bu gling dang gling phran rnams kyi mi dang dud 'gro brgya stong du ma za bar byed pa cig yod do/ /de 'dul ba'i don du slob dpon 'khor bcas rgya mtsho la cho 'phrul sna tshogs pas bzhud de/ gling de'i 'gram du phebs pa na/ gtso mo sna tshogs gzugs can nyid lha mo dang 'dra ba'i bud med kyi gzugs su bsgyur nas lam kha na 'dug go /slob dpon der byon pa na/ de na re/ rnal 'byor ba gang gi phyir 'gro zer/ bi shwa ru pi ni 'dul ba'i phyir ro gsungs pas/ de na re/ de ni gzugs dang yan lag mchog dang ldan pa/ yid gzhungs pa/ sems can mang po la phan par byed pa yin na/ de la gnod pa byar mi rung ngo zer/ slob dpon na re ma yin te/ nyin re bzhin skye bo brgya stong du ma la 'tshe bar byed pa'i phyir nges par 'dul lo/ /yang de ni rdzu 'phrul che ba yin na/ khyod kyis 'dul bar ga la nus zer/ slob dpon gyis de mthong bar 'gyur ro gsung pas/ skad cig de nyid la srin mo'i 'khor lnga brgya po yang snang bar gyur/ gtso mo rang yang 'jigs 'jigs ltar snang ba shin tu che ba'i gzugs su gyur te rngams pa'i tshul gyis 'ongs pa na/ slob dpon gyis de rnams la sdigs 'dzub bstan pas srin mo'i gtso mo de sgo thams cad nas khrag lhung bar gyur/ lhu tshigs thams cad zhig dran med du brgyal zhing myos/ 'khor thams cad kyang brgyal bog tshor ba drag pos gnad du gzir ro/ /der slob dpon gyis bka' bsgos shing dam la bzhag /sems can la 'tshe ba mi byed par mna' dor/ srin mo sna tshogs gzugs can ma nyid kyis slob dpon gyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal te/ slob dpon lam du bzhud pa'i tshe bzhed na skye bo kun gyis mthong bar bdag gzhon pa chibs kyi tshul du 'gro bar bgyid/

bzhugs pa'i tshe gdan gyi tshul du yang gnas par bgyid/ phal cher du mi snang ba'i tshul gyis rjes su song ste/ cho 'phrul sna tshogs pa ston pa dang*/ ma rung pa rnams tshar bcad par bgyi'o/ /zhes zhus shing slob dpon gyis kyang gnang ngo*/ /de nas lho phyogs kyi rgyud du yul tuṇ+ḍa maṇ+ḍal te/ bya mchu'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba na/ lha mo sing ga la te/ dmar ser ma'i rdo sku rang byung zhig byung ste mi ring ba'i dus yin/ der mu stegs kyis rnal 'byor ma 'phrul dang ldan pa rnams 'dus te/ nub re bzhin du rigs sngags kyi mthus mi re bkug ste tshogs su za bar byed do/ /der lan cig mi mang po zhig dus gcig tu bzung nas dus ston la za bar byed 'dod pa la/ slob dpon der byon te rnal 'byor ma rnams lta stangs dang phyag rgyas gzir bas/ thang la mi ro bzhin du 'gyel/ rdo sku yang kha bub tu gyur pa la zhabs kyis bsnun pas/ phyed 'khyogs par song*/ de rnams dam la bzhag ste srog chags la gnod pa mi byed par byas so/ /'di 'dra'i rigs kyi ma mo'i sku rang byung du grags pa phal cher skye gnas kyi phyag rgyar yod zhal phyag gi rnam pa can nyung yang*/ 'di zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du grags/ yang lho phyogs tam+pa la zhes bya ba'i yul du brtul zhugs kyi spyod pas bzhugs pa na/ phyogs de na mu stegs kyi rnal 'byor pa kriṣ+ṇa bhi ma zhes bya ba grub par grags pa cig yod de/ des slob dpon dang nus pa 'gran no zhes byas pa na/ rgyal po la sogs pa skye bo dpag tu med pa 'dus so/ /de na sangs rgyas pa'i lha khang gnas gzhi tsarma bi ha ra zhes bya ba gcig dang*/ mu stegs pa'i gnas gzhi su ka nā tha mā thu ra zhes bya ba zhig yod pa/ bar thag rgyang grags tsam mo/ /der kṛṣ+ta bhi mas nang ba'i gnas gzhi de'i lha khang la rdzas kyis gtor zhing sngags btab pas khrum gyis zhig la khang pa la/

slob dpon gyis lta stangs mdzad pas slar 'byor te 'dug go /slar yang mu stegs kyis rdzas sngags btab kyang ci yang ma gnod do/ /mu stegs kyi gnas gzhi de ni drung cig na yod pa de'i ltag gi brag ri la/ slob dpon spyod pa pas lta stangs mdzad pas/ ri'i rtse mo nyil nas mu stegs pa'i lha khang brgya rtsa brgyad non no/ /des slob dpon la lta stangs dang*/ sdigs 'dzub dang*/ khu tshur la sogs pa rnam 'gyur sna tshogs byas kyang gnod pa med la/ slob dpon gyis de la phar lta stangs mdzad pas/ de nyid zhag gcig tu lus rengs te 'jims gzugs ltar song zhing 'gyel/ ngag rengs te smra ma thub/ yid rengs te dran med du brgyal zhing myos so/ /de nas skye bo thams cad rab tu 'jigs shing ngo mtshar bar yang gyur/ mi mang pos gsol ba 'debs par byed cing*/ slob dpon gyis slar yang gso ba'i lta stangs mdzad pas/ kṛṣ+ṇa bhi ma yang rnal du gnas par gyur/ tam+pa la'i yul du re zhig mu stegs rgyun chad de sangs rgyas pa 'ba' zhig tu gyur skad/ yul der sngon 'phags pa sha na'i gos can gyis byon/ skye bo mang po bden pa la bkod/ bar du mu stegs kho nar song*/ yang klu sgrub kyi dus su nang pa dang*/ yang nub pa la chos kyi grags pa'i dus su dar ro/ /skabs der phyi nang gnyis ka yod pa la/ des nang pa kho na dar/ da lta'i bar du'ang sangs rgyas pa yod de yul 'di ni grong khyer bi d+ya na ga ra dang nye ba na yod do/ /yang yul bi ra dza pu ra zhes bya ba/ 'bigs byed kyi ri bo'i khongs kyi grong khyer de ba gha ṭa zer ba cig na/ log par lta ba'i rgyal po paṅga dza zhes pa zhig yod do/ /slob dpon 'khor bcas der byon zhing*/ skye bo mang po dag gis mchod par byed pa na/ rgyal po de rab tu khros nas nyin mo slob dpon grong khyer du gshegs pa'i lam gyi g.yas dang g.yon du glang po che gtum po mche ba lcags kyis g.yogs pa gsum gsum bzhag ste slob dpon byon pa na rbad do/

/der glang po che re re'i mdun du slob dpon re re byung glang po che'i snas bsnyabs shing mche bas bsnun par brtsams pa na/ de na gang yang med par glo g.yas g.yon nam rgyab kyi phyogs su slob dpon 'dug par mthong ngo*/ /yang de phyogs su gdong ltas te sna zhal gyis 'ching ba'am mche ba brnun pa'am brdzi bar brtsams na/ yang glang po nyid kyi rgyab bam g.yas g.yon du bzhugs par snang ngo*/ /rgyab na bzhugs pa la rkang pas 'phras na de na med par mdun du bzhugs so/ /tshul de lta bu'i dus 'das te glang po che rnams ngal zhing thang chad nas sa la 'gyel lo/ /de nas rgyal po des zhabs la gtugs shing bzod par gsol nas lta ba log pa yang dor ro/ /yang yul kong ka nar gshegs/ der zhing gi rnal 'byor ma mang po yang 'dus te tshogs kyi 'khor lor spyod pa na/ nub cig ḍā ma ru la sogs pa mchod pa'i rol mo'i sgra rnams las/ sgra shin tu snyan pa dag cher grags par gyur te yul de khyab bo/ /de thos pas grong khyer gyi mi rnams sgra des yid dbang med du drangs te/ slob dpon bzhugs pa'i phyogs der 'dus shing sgra de nyan cing 'dug go /de bzhin du phyugs rdzi rnams dang ri khrod pa rnams kyang ngo*/ /rta dang glang po dang ma he la sogs pa yang de nyan cing 'dus so/ /de bzhin du ri dwags dang bya sna tshogs dang gcan gzan sna tshogs pa dag kyang de nyan pa'i phyir 'dus shing 'dug go /de bzhin du lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin la sogs pa mi ma yin pa dag kyang 'dus te/ sems can de rnams thams cad sgra snyan po des 'khrul zhing myos pa'i ngang la mtshan mo de 'das te/ nang par nyi ma shar ba na slob dpon gyis snod chung ngu zhig nas ro mchog dang ldan pa'i kha zas sna tshogs pas mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad tshims par mdzad de/ khyed rnams rtag tu dge ba la spyod cig gsungs pas/ mi ma yin rnams na re lo lnga brgyar de ltar bgyi'o zer ro/

/de ni yul der de tsam nas bzung nas/ phyis mkhas pa sgo drug gi bar du mu stegs ngang gis nub cing nang ba 'ba' zhig rang shugs kyis dar ba la lta ba yin skad/ yang dus gcig na yul tsa ri tra zhes bya ba/ grong khyer tse t+ya pā ṭa na te mchod rten grong zhes bya ba na bzhugs so/ /gnas de ru rdo rje phag mos srid pa gsum gyi chang 'gugs par grags te/ chang tshong ma'i grong bdun brgya la sbyar ba'i chang rnams chang snod du rdzas sbyor thengs re dang*/ 'bru chang rnams 'bru btsos pa phabs dang sbyor thengs re la ji srid du chang lan mang du bsings nas mthar rdzas kyi tshigs ma'am/ 'bru'i sbang ma bcud med par song ba'i tshe/ chu tshod re tsam kha bsdams te bzhag pa na/ slar yang gsar par log yong ba de 'dra ba lan bdun gyi bar du 'byung ba yin par 'dug /deng sang yang grong re re tsam la 'byung nges pa dang*/ dus bzang la lung pa thams cad chang gi dris khyab pa yong nges yin par 'dug /de'i rgyal po in du mā la zer ba zhig /nyi ma 'ba' zhig lhar 'dzin la lta ba log pas gnas pa'o/ /de tshes bcu gnyis kyi mchod pa zhig la/ lcags ri rim pa bdun gyis bskor ba'i nang*/ nyi ma'i lha khang du srog chags brgya stong du ma bsad pa'i mchod pa byed do/ /de'i dus la bab pa cig na/ lcags ri rim pa bdun gyi sgo ni bsdams/ phyi rol tu bsrung ba du ma bzhag /mchod pa byed pa'i bram ze dang*/ rgyal po 'khor bcas nang na yod de/ srog chags rnams kyang bcings te bzhag go /der slob dpon spyod pa ba gcig pu sgo drung du phebs nas/ sgo srung lnga brgya tsam la lta stangs mdzad pas/ thams cad dbang du gyur te 'dzum dmul zhing 'dug go /sgo rim pa thams cad rang bye ste mchod pa'i gnas su byon/ mchod sbyin gyi don du bcings pa'i mi dang dud 'gro'i tshogs pa la lta stangs mdzad pas thag pa rnams rang chad la song*/ bram ze'i mchod pa'i sbyin sreg gi thab la lta stangs mdzad pas/

me de skad cig gis cher mched nas phyogs de thams cad mes khyab pa'i snang ba shar te rgyal po 'khor bcas 'jigs te bros so/ /de nas rgyal po dang bram ze de dag slob dpon gyis mthu bstan par shes nas/ zhabs la phyag btsal zhing gsung bzhin sgrub par khas blangs/ de dag kyang sangs rgyas la dad pa la bkod nas yul gzhan du bzhud do/ /yang lho phyogs ma l+ya ra'i yul dang nye ba/ ha ri ke la zhes bya bar bzhud de/ yul de na gnas chen du byed pa ri shin tu che ba zhig yod/ deng sang ni tsan+d+ra ku ma ra zer gyin 'dug go /ri de'i drung du tshogs khang bcos der tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i rol pa rgya chen po mdzad pa'i skabs shig sgo drung na ma he mo phru gur btsas pa 'jogs gin yod pa las/ yul de'i mi dpon zhig gis rnal 'byor pa nus pa yod med blta'o byas nas/ nyi ma gung gi dus zhig tshogs kyi khang pa'i sgo bsdams te 'dug pa las/ ma he mo ma smad gnyis brkus nas song ngo*/ /der gom pa lnga bcu tsam song nas phyi mig bltas pas/ ma he mo phru gur bcas pa sngar gyi shul na 'dug ste/ phan tshun du bltas na shin tu 'dra bar mthong*/ yang mi zhig btang ste de yang brkus so/ /yang sngar bzhin phyi mig bltas pa na/ sngar gyi shul na snga ma bzhin 'dug ste/ de yang brkus pa sogs lan bdun gyi bar du de bzhin du byung ngo*/ /de nas ma he mo bdun dang phru gu bdun thob bo snyam na/ ma bu gnyis las gzhan mi 'dug go /sngar gyi shul la phyi mig bltas pas/ sngar gyi shul na ma bu gnyis 'dug go /des bsams pa da ci'i ma he mo dang be'u de 'di yin nam cig shos de yin/ 'di las gang zhig bden gang zhig rdzun mi shes so snyam ste/ lhan cig tu khrid pa de yang bor te song ngo*/ /de nas des rnal 'byor pa'i rnam 'phrul dang mngon shes 'jug tshul ngo mtshar bar shes nas/ rang nyid rgyal srid phyed kyi 'byor pa spangs te/

slob dpon gyi 'khor du rnal 'byor ba byas so/ /de ni la bā yi pa yin par grags/ yang yul tri ling ga'i rgyal pos slob dpon 'khor bcas mchod par byas pa'i skabs shig phyogs de dang nye ba'i dur khrod aṭ+ṭaṭ+ṭa ha sa te ha ha sgrog par byon/ der tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i spyod pa yun ring du mdzad/ yo byad 'byor pa dpag tu med pa rgyal pos phul zhing*/ yul gyi bram ze dang*/ rgyal rigs kyi bu dang*/ tshong dpon dang*/ zhing pa dang*/ gdol pa la sogs pa skye bo mang po dang*/ bud med lnga brgya tsam mchod pa'i don du 'dus pa las/ tshogs kyi bza' ba'i khyad par las kha rbū dza ste shing thog rgyal mo ga gon re gcig yod pa brgya stong du 'phel te kun la stsal ba/ de rnams kyis zos pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ dbab pa'i lta stangs mdzad pas thams cad la ye shes phebs te/ lus ngag gi rnam 'gyur dang rdzu 'phrul/ cho 'phrul sna tshogs pa bstan to/ /rjes su de thams cad rnal 'byor pho mor gyur te/ ting nge 'dzin bzang po 'ba' zhig thob pa stong phrag mang po byung zhing dngos grub thob pa'ang mang po'o/ /yang yul daṇ+ḍa ka ra ṇ+ya zhes bya ba lho phyogs khā na'i yul dang nye ba zhig na bzhugs te/ gnas de na mtsho rdzing bzang po zhig yod/ skye bo rnams kyang de las 'thung ba la der nag phyogs kyi klu gdugs pa can gnyis glo bur du 'ongs te/ dug sbrul gyi gzugs kyis dngos su chu 'thungs pas kha'i dug gi mtsho de ma rungs par byas so/ /de na nang pa'i gnas gzhi zhig yod pa'i dge slong dang*/ dge bsnyen 'ga' res mtsho rdzing de las chu 'thung pas dug sbrul gyi kha chu 'dres pa'i dug gis de ma thag shi'o/ /de slob dpon gyis gsan nas mtsho 'gram der byon pas/ mtsho 'khrugs pa'i gseb nas gdug pa'i klu de gnyis byung ste/ slob dpon gyi sku la 'ching bar sems te 'khril yang der gnod pa ni ma nus/

slob dpon gyis dgongs pa brtad de/ sku lus bgang bas gdug pa'i klu sbrul gyi gzugs can de gnyis kyi lus dum bu brgya phrag brgya phrag tu chad/ yun ring du sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba drag pos gzir du bcug go /slar gus pas gsol ba 'debs pa na/ sems can la gnod pa mi byed par dam la bzhag nas/ yang gso ba'i lta stangs kyis rjes su gzung chu'i dug kyang bsdus/ sngar gyi mi shi ba rnams kyang thal mo brdab pa'i sgra mdzad pas gsos so/ /der slob dpon ni gdug pa'i sbrul 'dul bar byon song zhes slob ma rnams kyis thos te bltar 'ongs bas yul de'i skye bo phal cher de na 'dus/ klu btul zin nas klu de dag dang klu sbrul gyi gzugs can dpag tu med pa 'dus nas/ khang bzang gi rnam par byas pa'i dbus na slob dpon bzhugs so/ /skye bo thams cad de la blta zhing ngo mtshar du byed par gyur/ de nas sbrul de dag mi snang bar song zhing skye bo'i tshogs de dag kyang gyes so/ /yul der sngags kyi theg pa bshad pas kyang skye bo mang pos dngos grub thob par grags so/ /de dag gi skabs shigadapal o rgyan gyi gnas kyi rgyal po dig de ba ste phyogs kyi lha zhes pas slob dpon spyan drangs te yun yang ring du bzhugs shing*/ phyogs de na gnas pa'i mu stegs kyi rnal 'byor pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma nus pa thob pa mang po zhig lta stangs dang*/ cho 'phrul gyis btul/ de'i shugs kyis phyi ba'i phyogs 'dzin pa'i rgyal phran dang paṇ+ḍi ta nyi shu tsam nang par gyur skad/ re re bzhin gyi lo rgyus rgyas par ma bris kyang*/ la la dbang du byed pa'i lta stangs kyis dbang du bsdus/ la la rengs par mdzad pa sogs kyis bsdigs/ la la gcig dang du ma dang 'bar ba la sogs pa'i cho 'phrul bstan/ la la sems shes pa'i mngon shes sogs bstan pas dad pa bskyed pa yin no/ /der dur khrod chen po gho ra an+dha kar tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na/

dpal he ru ka 'khor lo sdom pa rig pa'i lha mor bcas pa mngon sum du byon pas slob dpon nyid rab tu dgyes te ro langs mang po dang lhan cig tu sngags kyi bstod pa dang bcas te gar dang skor ba mdzad pas/ keng rus dang ce spyang rnams kyang gar byed do/ /mi bzad pa'i lus can mang pos kyang mchod par byed do/ /de'i tshe dpal he ru kas sngags kyi sgra dbyangs sngon du 'gro bas/ kyai 'jig rten ma rig 'thibs po'i smag gis mun par sprul pa la/ /mtshan mo sprin rum stug po'i nang nas glog 'gyu gsal 'bar bzhin/ /rab tu gnyen gshin 'jam pa'i blo gros phyogs grol ltar yang las/ /nyi ma bye ba phrag brgya las lhag 'od kyis snang bar gyis/ /gang las rnam pa drug gi ngag tshig dpyod gsal bas/ /bde dang ye shes rnam shes thar ba'i don ldan pa/ /sna tshogs spyod dang nus pa snying la 'jug 'gyur ba'i/ /skye bo'i rab rib sel byed mngon par sbyor bar gyis/ /zhes dbugs phyung zhing snang ba byin no/ /de nas slob dpon gyis/ srid pa gsum 'bar sku ni rjes chags dul bar ldan/ /sogs kyis bstod pas/ ha ha he he la sogs pa bzhad pa brgyad kyis bzhad de mi snang bar gyur to/ /yang phyis dza lan+dha rar yang bzhud de/ sa 'og nas rdo rings chen po dpangs su 'dom brgyad/ rgyar 'dom gang pa cig bton te phyag ya gcig gis bsnams nas/ ko ne dza'i grong khyer gyi mthar btsugs so/ /rdo rings de da lta yang yod do/ /gnas der yang rdo rje theg pa'i zab mo'i don ci rigs pa gsungs/ yang yul ra dha'i rgyal pos gsol ba btab nas/ so ma pu ri'i lha khang zhig la rab gnas mdzad/ skye bo thams cad kyis mthong bar lha khang nam mkha' la lan gsum du 'phags shing*/ lha rnams gar byed par snang ngo*/ /'di so ma pu ri rnying pa yin/ phyis byung ba cha gsum gyi gtsug lag khang ni so ma pu ri gsar ba ste/

rgyal po de ba pā las so ma ru ra'i gnas gzhi dang grong rnams sa yul gsar par dpos pas snga ma'i ming de ka gsar pa la'ang grags so/ /yul bi ra dzar byon pa'i lo rgyus nas de dag gi bar gyi gtam rnams 'dir bshad pa'i go rim yin gyi/ dus snga phyi sna tshogs yod par snang la de dag ni slob dpon ku sa li chung bas mdzad pa'i gnas kyi sgron me zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos kyi thog mar bshad pa'i gtam rgyud ltar bris pa'o/ /spyir yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang dur khrod brgyad de sum cu rtsa gnyis su ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa bstan pa'i lo rgyus dang*/ rgyas pa la gnas bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad dang*/ dur khrod bcu drug du byon pa'i gtam rgyud kyang yod par snang zhing*/ tsar+ya pa rnams kyi sde na de dag gi glegs bam yang yod ces thos so/ /de nas phyis shig na/ yul chen po shar phyogs bhaṅga la na sngar gyi rgyal po go bi tsan+d+ra'i tsha bo rgyal po rol pa'i zla ba rgyal srid skyong zhing*/ de'i blon po ni dge ba'i mgon po'o/ /der rgyal po la sogs pa yul khams kyi skye bo gzhan thams cad mu stegs byed kho na la mos shing*/ blon po dge ba'i mgon po 'khor bcas nyid nang pa'o/ /slob dpon nag po spyod pa 'khor stong bzhi brgya dang bcas pa/ gdugs bdun brgya dang*/ ḍā ma ru bdun brgya dang*/ 'khor tshogs thams cad la yang cho 'phrul sna re dang bcas bhaṃ ga la'i grong khyer du byon no/ /de dus kyi grong khyer ni he ma da la yin par 'dug da lta de stongs nas nags su yod zer/ der skye bo thams cad ngo mtshar du 'dzin bzhin pa las/ blon po dge ba'i mgon pos mchod par byas shing*/ grong khyer gyi dbus dang phyogs bzhi thams cad du khyab par nyul bar mdzad/ rgya gar gyi grong khyer chen po rnams la phyogs mtshams brgyad kar du dur khrod yod pas/ phyogs mtshams kyi dur khrod brgyad rnams su nges pa med par bzhugs shing skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la zab mo'i don gyi bka' drin yang mdzad do/

/der blon po dge ba'i mgon pos yo byad bzang la gya nom pas mchod bzhin pa la dus ring tsam song ba na/ lan cig dge ba'i mgon po drung du 'ongs ba zhig la/ khyod kyis nga la mang du sbyin pa ni gang gi don du yin gsung*/ bdag gi skyed mos tshal na/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi lha khang zhig bzhengs yod pas/ de la slob dpon gyis rab tu gnas pa mdzad par zhu zhus pas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas 'o na deng nyid tshes dang gza' dang skar ma dang sbyor ba dang byed pa mtha' dag bzang bas/ da lta rang bya gsung*/ yo byad ji lta bu 'tshal zhus pas/ gang yang mi dgos gsung*/ lha khang du bzhud pa'i lam nas me tog cig bsnams/ lha khang du byon nas sku gzugs kyi spyi bor me tog bzhag ste/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha gsungs nas rab gnas tshar ro gsungs/ der blon po dge pa'i mgon po yid ma ches pas/ slob dpon na re/ khyod yid ma ches na ngas rab gnas brtul te 'gro'o zhes gsung*/ dbu thog tu bzhag pa'i me tog de blangs te slob dpon bzhud pa na/ spyan ras gzigs kyi sku gzugs de yang bkag ste bzhengs nas slob dpon gyi phyi bzhin du thegs/ slob dpon bzhugs pas dur khrod du byon no/ /der blon po 'gyod de dur khrod der song*/ sngar yid ma ches pa la bshags pa phul te/ da ni yid ches pas rab gnas mdzad par zhu zhus pas/ sngar bzhin me tog sku gzugs kyi spyi bor bzhag /sku gzugs 'od 'phro zhing gzi brjid dang ldan par song*/ de nas blon po dge ba'i mgon pos spyan ras gzigs kyi sku gzugs de spyan 'dren par brtsams na/ mi gnyis dang bzhi dang brgyad dang bcu drug nas brtsams te/ lnga brgya'i bar gyis kyang g.yo 'gul byed ma nus te gnas de nyid du lha khang bzhengs/ de la ni rgas+thā pa na zhes grags/ sngar gyi lha khang der yang mchod rten lha can zhig byas so/ /sngar bod na yod pa'i lo rgyus na/

'dir rgyal po'i chad pa byung gi dogs pas lha dbang phyug chen po'i rnam pa dang 'dra ba'i spyan ras gzigs bzhengs zer ba 'dug /'on kyang sku 'dra de phyis kla klo'i 'jigs pas/ gang ga sā ga ra zhes pa rgya mtsho'i de'u cig la spyan drangs nas da lta yod 'dug pa/ mthong ba rnams zer ba ltar na 'phags pa ha lā ha lā zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa de yin yod 'dug pa de ni gdod nas dbang phyug zhi ba dang rnam pa phyogs 'dra ba yin gyi/ mu stegs pa'i lha dang 'dra bar rdzus te bcos pa min no/ /de nas blon po dge ba'i mgon pos gsol ba btab pa la/ de skal ba dang ldan par mkhyen nas/ dbang bskur zhing gdams pa dang rjes su gdams pa yang stsal lo/ /spyir btang la/ dpa' bo'i dbang phyug mi 'bri zhing*/ /gang gi thad du'ang mi gdon no/ /zhes 'byung ba yin kyang*/ skabs der mkha' 'gros lung bstan te/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bris sku zhig blon po nyid kyi yi dam du bzhengs so/ /de shin tu gsang shing mtshan mo bsgom bzlas dang mchod gtor byed kyin yod pa las/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis bsgrags te/ blon po dge ba'i mgon pos rgyal po'i lha gdan du btang ba'i lha sku bzhengs yod par 'dug ces grong khyer ba kun la grags so/ /der blon po'i nye du dang grogs po 'ga' zhig na re/ khyed kyis 'di lta bu bzhengs 'dug pa/ de yul gzhan zhig tu brdzangs na legs/ gal te rgyal pos khyim g.yengs btang ste snyed na khyod kyi mgo gcod par 'gyur zhes zer/ der blon po skrag ste bris sku de snod du bcug gos mang pos g.yogs te mi ro yin pa ltar rdzus te khyogs la bteg /lho sgo nas brdzangs pas sgo de'i sgo srungs pa the tshom zos te bzung nas bltas pas bris sku der 'dug de dbyug pa'i rtse mor btags te rgyal po'i drung du khyer/ grong khyer ba rnams smra ba ni bden te blon po dge ba'i mgon po'i 'di lta bu bris so zhes byas/

rgyal pos blon po gzhan dang bros pa rnams bsags te gros byis pas/ dge ba'i mgon po gsal shing la bskyon nam/ mgo chod cig ces thams cad mgrin gcig tu smra'o/ /rgyal po na re/ khyed rnams ma brtags pa kho nar smra'am/ rgyal po zhes bya ba brtags shing dpyad nas byed dgos pas/ ngas brtags par bya'o zhes dge ba'i mgon po bos so/ /de la bris sku bstan nas nga'i lha mnan pa'i sku 'bri ba 'di/ khyod kyis dran nam/ khyod rang gi slob dpon gyis dran/ sus dran pa de la chad pa gcod gsung*/ blon po na re/ 'di bdag gis dran pa yang ma yin/ slob dpon gyi dran pa yang ma yin gyi nang pa sangs rgyas pa rang gi gzhung nas bshad zhus pas/ rgyal po yid ma ches pa la khyim nas glegs bam blangs te bstan pas/ rgyal po na re/ de na bden mod kyi gzhung lugs 'di gnyis gang bden nus pa 'gran no zhes gsungs nas/ rgyal pos kyang he ru ka gdan du byas pa'i bris sku bzhengs so/ /ri mo'i bya ba zin pa na/ rgyal po na re/ khyod kyi bris sku dang*/ nga'i bris sku gdan mtho dma' med pa cig la bzhag sgo bsdams te khyed dang nged kyi mi su yang mi 'gro/ mchod pa rgya chen po yang mnyam por 'bul/ gsol ba yang mnyam por 'debs/ de ltar zhag bdun song nas rang re gnyis kar phyogs mi dang bcas pa mnyam por 'ongs te ngo mtshar pa'i ltas kyi nus pa blta ba yin no/ /de rjes gang nus pa dang ldan pa de'i rjes su cig shos nus pa med pa de 'jug dgos so/ /zhes byas nas bris sku gnyis lha khang gsar ba cig gi nang du bzhag zhag bdun du de ltar byed pa las/ blon pos rgyal po'i bka' 'gong bar ni mi nus pas de ltar byas kyang*/ khong 'dar bas lan cig slob dpon gyi drung du song nas/ 'di ltar byed dgos byung bas slob dpon gyis nus pa bstan par zhu byas tsa na/ slob dpon gyi gsung na re/ khyod sems las chung ngur 'dug cing*/

don 'di la ngas nus pa ston mi dgos kyi/ bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka phyugs bdag gis brji bar ga la nus gsung ste/ dur khrod rnams su glu dang gar la sogs pa rol ba sna tshogs pas bzhugs so/ /de nas zhag brgyad pa'i nyin par rgyal po dang blon po gnyis/ sangs rgyas pa dang mu stegs byed kyi phyogs 'dzin rnams dang bcas te/ lhan cig lha khang der zhugs nas bris sku gnyis dus gcig tu zhal phye'o/ /der bris sku snga ma dpal he ru ka ni sngar bas kyang ches gzi brjid 'bar bar 'dug /rgyal pos bzhengs pa'i bris sku de yang snga ma las rang 'gyur nas/ dbang phyug chen po dang lha mo u ma mnan pa'i dpal he ru ka'i sku brnyan nyid du gyur ro/ /der thams cad kyis bris sku la mchod cing*/ rgyal rnga chen po yang brdungs te/ da phyin chad rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa sangs rgyas pa byed do zhes dril bsgrags so/ /de nas rgyal pos kyang slob dpon spyod pa pa'i zhabs la gtugs/ dbang bskur zhus shing gdams pa nod/ phyis dus gzhan na rgyal blon 'di gnyis kyang dngos grub thob/ dus der re zhig rgyal blon bram ze tshong dpon khyim bdag sogs thams cad sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa kho na mchod de yul lha mchod pa dang*/ gsangs te mchod pa'i rigs ma gtogs/ bhaṅga la ba ril gyis sangs rgyas par gyur/ yul gru chen po de de ltar gyur pas/ shin tu ya mtshan pa'i dbang du byas nas/ sku gzugs rnam par 'gyur ba'i gtam zhes lo rgyus 'di rgya gar na grags che'o/ /yul der yang sngags kyi bstan pa shin tu dar bar gyur/ slob dpon 'dis kyang de skabs yun ring du bzhugs so/ /de nas lan cig da ni dur khrod chen po brgyad dam bcu drug dang*/ yul chen gzhan thams cad ni bgrod zin pas/ da ni de bī ko ṭar yang 'gro'o dgongs so/ /de nas bhaṅga la'i yul bsgral te bar gyi yul khams ba ren+d+ra zhes bya bar byon/

der yang dus ci rigs pa song ba na/ nyin gcig grong khyer du gshegs pa'i lam ka cig na/ chu shing dang*/ dzam+bu dang*/ arma la sogs pa'i 'bras bu can gyi shing sna tshogs pa'i tshal cig gi 'gram na/ de bsrung ba'i bu mo zhig 'dug nas/ slob dpon gyi 'khor lhan cig rgyu ba'i rnal 'byor ba dag gis de la shing 'bras slongs so/ /bu mo de na re/ khyod rang rnams nus pa dang ldan par rlom gyin 'dug pa/ nus pas shing thog phob la zo zer/ slob dpon gyis lhung ba'i lta stangs mdzad pas shing thog thams cad nyil gyis byung*/ sa la ma reg tsam la bu mo des rdzi ma gyen du bskyod pa'i lta stangs byas pa tsam gyis/ yang shing thog de rnams gyen la yar song nas rang gnas su 'byar te 'dug go /de nas slob dpon gyis lta stangs kyis mar la phab/ bu mo'i lta stangs kyis yar la 'byar ba de gnyis/ re mos 'ba' zhig gi tshul gyis ring zhig thogs so/ /mthar bu mo de na re/ nus pa cung zad tsam la nga brgyal bar mi bya la/ zhing mtha' dag rang du rgyu bar yang mi bya'o zer nas mi snang bar song ngo*/ /bu mo de ni rdo rje phag mo'o/ /de nas dus gzhan zhig na/ slob dpon nyid 'khor dang bcas pa/ yul kats+tsha raṅga'i mda' bod kyi ri dang nye ba'i phyogs yul de bī ko ṭar byon no/ /der rnal 'byor pa'i gnas gzhi gcig kyang mdzad/ da ni 'dir yang 'ongs pas/ dzam+bu gling gi dur khrod chen po rnams dang*/ yul chen po rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi brtul zhugs kyi spyod pas bgrod par bya ba'i zhing thams cad bgrod zin gyi/ phyin chad gzhan du mi 'gro bar 'dir 'dug go gsung ngo*/ /der dus ring zhig song ba na 'phra men ma chen mo mu stegs kyi mkha' 'gro ma zhig rigs bar ma'i khyim du mi'i skye ba'i gzugs bstan pa'i ming ni pa hu rī zhes zer ba zhig yod do/ /de don du ni ma mo spyi'i pho nya mo kā la daṇ+ḍī bharta kā li nyid yin skad/

de lo bcu drug ma tsam du gyur pa na/ yul de'i rten gyi gtso bo sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel can gyi mchod rten gcig bzhugs pa'i rtse mor phra men ma des ma mo'i skye gnas kyi phyag rgya bzhag go /de yun ring du de khar bzhag na yul de'i nye skor gyi sangs rgyas pa thams cad brlag par 'gyur par slob dpon gyis mkhyen nas gsungs pas slob dpon gyi slob ma rnams kyis skye gnas kyi phyag rgya de blangs te/ chu bo chen por dor ro/ /de la des 'khon du bltas nas 'dug go /lan cig slob dpon grong khyer du bzhud pa'i lam gcig na/ gdug pa'i mkha' 'gro ma de gtun shing thogs nas 'bras brdung zhing 'dug go /de dang nye bar slob dpon 'khor bcas byon pa na/ lus kyis slob dpon la ma gus pa'i rnam 'gyur ston cing sangs rgyas pa spyi la kha zer ro/ /der slob dpon gyis lta stangs mdzad pas 'bras kyi gtun dang gtun bu tshal par gas/ des kyang slob dpon la lta stangs byas mod cang ma gnod do/ /yang des slob dpon gyi 'khor rnams la lta stangs yang yang byas pas/ phal cher la ma gnod kyang*/ kha cig la gos tshig pa dang 'gyel ba dag byung ngo*/ /slob ma de rnams kyis zhus nas yang slob dpon gyis lta stangs mdzad pas/ phra men ma de kha bub tu ltung ba dang*/ lag pa gnyis sa la lhung ngo*/ /der slob dpon thugs snying rje cung zad skyes pas lag pa gnyis gso ba'i lta stangs kyis 'byar bar mdzad do/ /des sngags bzlas shing slob dpon la lta stangs byed do/ /snying rje'i shugs kyis thugs yengs te bsrung ba g.yel ba'i rnam pa cung zad cig byung ba yin nam zer/ slob dpon rang gi gnas gzhir phebs pa na/ shin tu bsnyung par gyur te/ slob dpon na re/ 'di lta bu ni bla ma'i gsung las de bī ko ṭar ma 'gro zhes gsung na/ bka' de bcag pa'i nyes pa yin gyi/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang*/

dur khrod brgyad du dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams la tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang bshags pa gyis shig de nas kyang lang la shog zhag bdun gyi khongs su 'khor bar gyis gsung*/ de nas slob ma rkang mgyogs kyi grub pa thob pa mang pos/ skad cig la myur bar de rnams byas te/ tshur log 'ongs pas/ tshan gcig gis sman thogs te 'ongs pa la/ lam dang nye ba na bud med mang pos pad+ma'i mtsho la khrus byed de/ de rnams na re rnal 'byor pa khrus gyis zer/ slob dpon bsnyung bas long ba med do byas pa na/ de rnams na re/ bsnyung ba gdangs zer/ sman rnams chu 'gram du bzhag nas khrus cung zad byas pas/ sman de dag bud med de rnams kyis khyer nas gar song cha med do/ /de nas nang du 'ongs nas slob dpon dang mjal ba na/ bud med de dag sngar gyi mkha' 'gro ma des sprul pa yin gsung*/ de nas slob ma'i mchog rnal 'byor pho mo bdun bcu rtsa gnyis bos te/ sku'i drung du gnas pa la/ slob dpon na re/ da res bla ma'i bka' bcag pa'i chad pa zlog tu med pa yin/ da bar dor mchog gi dngos grub bsgrubs te slar 'ong ba yin pas de bar du 'dir yang ma yong zhig gsungs nas/ sgo bsdams te bzhugs so/ /der slob ma rnams kyis shin tu gsang bar byas kyang gdug pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis de slar byung na bdag cag phung bar 'gyur zhes 'gros nas/ sku 'das so shes bsgrags pa'i rkyen gyis bram ze dang rtsis mkhan rnams kyis tshor nas rgyal po la zhus te/ de dag rgyal po'i mi dang bcas pa 'ongs nas/ zhag lnga ba'i nyin mo sgo phye bas slob dpon sku 'das par mthong*/ slob ma 'ga' dang bram ze dang rtsis mkhan rnams kyis tsan+dan la sogs pa'i bud shing khyer te/ dud khrod chen por sku gdung spyan drangs pa na/ skad cig de nyid la ral gri la sogs pa'i dngos grub brgyad cu rtsa bzhi las re re ster bar byed pa po/

gdod nas grub pa'i grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi 'khor mang po dang bcas pa gang nas byung cha med par 'ongs pas/ bram ze la sogs pa mi de rnams de dag gi gzi brjid ma bzod gdung bas tshig par gyur te/ cung zad bros nas rgyang ring po nas skye bo'i tshogs rnams dang lhan cig lta ba las gdung la nye bar 'gro ma thub bo/ /grub thob de rnams kyis bar snang la dkyil 'khor bris pa'i dbus su sku gdung bzhag ste/ rang byung gi me 'od kyis sbyangs so/ /dus der mya ngan gyi shugs yod pa ltar ston pa dang*/ rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa de dag blta bar 'ongs pa'i rnal 'byor pho mo stong phrag brgya cu rtsa bzhi dang*/ glo bur du lhags pa gzhan 'bum phrag du ma 'dus te gnas pa la/ zhag bdun pa'i tha mar slob dpon nyid sngon bzhin du gdugs bdun brgya dang*/ ḍa ma ru bdun brgya dang*/ snang ba'i 'khor bdun brgya dang*/ mi snang ba'i 'khor bdun brgyar bcas pa mngon sum du byon byung ba na/ rnal 'byor ba thams cad ngo mtshar skyes nas bsu ba byas shing*/ sa phyogs mtho ba cig la slob dpon bzhugs te/ so so la chos kyi bka' mchid mang du mdzad do/ /de'i mthar nga'i lus ga re zhes gsung ba la/ bsregs zin to zhes zhus pas/ do ha rdo rje glu dbyangs mchog dang bcas pas sku'i snang ba de dang 'khor stong bzhi brgya yang mi snang bar gyur ro/ /gdung zhugs la phul ba'i gnas skabs der/ sa g.yo ba dang*/ 'od kyis khyab pa dang*/ spos kyi dri ngad phyogs thams cad du ldang ba dang*/ nam mkha' nas rol mo'i sgra dang*/ me tog gi char chen po byung ngo*/ /de nyin yar ngo'i tshes bcu gnyis yin/ de bī ko ṭar da lta yang zhag dus de la sgra 'od me tog gi char sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas re rtag tu 'ong ba yin par 'dugader gdung zhugs la zhen pa de mi legs pa chen po byung zer nas/ da nas brtsams te da lta'i bar du rgya gar ba'i rnal 'byor pa rnams phung po bsreg sbyang mi byed do/

/de nas re zhig shar phyogs kyi rgyal khams de bī ko ṭa dang*/ ba ren+d+ra dang*/ kā ma ru pa dang*/ he ram+pa dang*/ shrī ha ṭ+ṭa dang*/ bhaṅga la dang*/ o ḍi bi sha dang*/ ra dha la sogs pa'i ljongs rnams su yul phyogs grong khyer thams cad rnal 'byor pho mos khyab pa lta bur yod pa la/ ji zhig ltar nas 'di 'di na 'di ltar gnas/ 'di ltar song zhes brjod du med par phal cher mi snang ngo*/ /dus de skabs shig ma ru'i yul gyi puskā ra zhes pa'i yul du slob dpon 'di nyid phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa mngon sum du byon/ nub phyogs kyi yul sna tshogs su phebs/ skal ldan gyi skye bo mang po gnas lugs rtogs pa la bkod/ zla ba 'ga' re bzhugs nas mthar gar gshegs cha med do/ /lho phyogs kar+ṇa ṭa kar ni bar dor mchog bsgrubs te sngar gyi sku lus de nyid la zhugs nas mngon sum du byon pa yin ces 'gro ba mang po la bcud len sogs gnang ste phan 'dogs pa dang*/ dbul 'phongs dang nad pa mang po'i sdug bsngal bsal/ 'ga' zhig la gdams ngag kyang cung zad bstan par mdzad de zla ba bzhi tsam bzhugs par grags/ yul de'i phyogs gcig she ya gi ri zhes bya ba na/ de ltar byon pa'i dus kyi mchod pa da lta yang yod do/ /byang phyogs gaṅga dang ya mu na'i bar mtshams ma la bu ri zhes bya bar sngar gyi sku lus la zhugs te der byon pa yin gsungs nas sngar brtul zhugs spyod pa'i dus la ma sleb pas nyes/ da spyod pa'i dus la bab na lus la rang byung gi phyag rgya drug 'byung bar shog ces gsungs nas/ zla ba drug tu rtse gcig tu bsgom pa ltar mdzad/ de nas sku la rus pa'i rgyan drug rang byung du yang byung*/ zhag bdun du spros bcas kyi spyod pa mdzad par kun gyis mthong ngo*/ /de nas zung 'jug gi sku bsnyes te mi snang bar gyur skad/ yang ma ga dha dang nye ba lho phyogs dza ri khaṇ+ḍar gtogs pa'i de ba gha ṭa zhes bya ba'i grong khyer du bram ze'i rigs su gtogs pa cig gi khyim du skye ba bzhes te/

sku la rus pa'i rgyan drug rang byung du yod par sku bltams/ de ma thag nga sngon gyi slob dpon nag po yin gyi lam lhag ma rnams lus 'di la rdzogs par 'gyur gsung nas/ btsas ma thag nas bsgom par mdzad/ zla ba gcig tsam na sku lus kyi bskyed rdzogs shing*/ de nas kyang mnyam bzhag 'ba' zhig la bzhugs zla ba drug gi mtha' yang zer/ lo gcig la yang zer/ sgra dang 'od dang me tog gi char sogs cho 'phrul dang bcas te mi snang bar gyur te zung 'jug gi sku brnyes pa'o/ /yul de na yang mchod pa dang*/ dus ston gyi rnam grangs re da lta'i bar du yang yod do/ /tshul de lta bus phyi rjes su yang cho 'phrul mtha' yas pa bstan to/ /de ltar na rnam thar gtam rgyud de dag ni/ slob dpon grub thob ku sa li pa'i gsung lo rgyus kyi sdoms la srogs shing bcol te/ rgya bod kyi lo rgyus gzhan yid ches yod nges rnams las kha bskang ste bris pa yin pas shin tu rnam par dag pa sem mo/ /slob dpon 'dis dang po yul dza lan+dha ra nas byon pa'i dus nas/ phyis de bī ko ṭar phebs pa'i bar la slob dpon nyid kyis chos bstan pa dang*/ gzhan yang mig ltos kyi bdag rkyen la brten nas skye bo dpag tu med pa cig sngags kyi theg pa la zhugs te rnal 'byor pho mor gyur pas/ grong khyer bcu gsum tsam stongs skad pa'i grong khyer ni byang phyogs ma la'i grong ste 'phrog byed sgo dang*/ nub phyogs arban+ti ste/ mā la pa dang*/ kān+ti ste lho phyogs kha na'i yul dang*/ bi rā dza ste lho phyogs bi dza pu ra dang*/ pun+ṭa bar+dha ste shar phyogs li kha ra shing 'phel dang*/ ka na ka ste lho phyogs ma ra ha ṭa'i nang tshan cig dang*/ grong khyer ka ra n+ya te lho phyogs go dha ba ri dang nye ba dang*/ tsi ti pa ṭa na ste lho phyogs tsa ri tra dang*/ he ma da la ste shar phyogs bhaṅga la'i khyad par dang*/ yul byang phyogs gan+dha ra ste deng sang ṭi lar grags pa dang*/

de bā gha ṭa ste lho phyogs dza ri khaṇ+ḍa'i bye brag cig dang*/ shar lho grong khyer ga ling ka dang*/ yul dbus rau da si dang*/ nub phyogs grong khyer pu kā ra rnams so/ /de dag kyang skor tse skor tse stongs pa rang min gyi/ grong khyer de dang de'i cha lag yul khams thams cad nas/ skyes pa bud med khye'u bu mo rnams rnal 'byor pho mo byas pa'i grangs rnams bgrangs na/ phyi lcags ris bskor ba'i grong khyer tshad ldan gcig gi grong mi'i grangs su longs pa re'i dbang du byas pas grong de tsam bse ba tshegs su stongs pa ste/ de yang rgya gar gyi grong khyer re re la yang mi grong khri phrag mang po'am/ 'bum phrag bgrang pa yod do/ /yang rtag tu rjes su 'brang ba'i 'khor stong dang bzhi brgya ni/ dngos grub kyi rnam grangs re re thob pa 'ba' zhig ste/ de'i phyed bdun brgya ni dgos pa yod na mi rnams la ston par byed la/ de yang sprul pas ston par byed kyi lus dngos mis mthong ba min no/ /gzhan gnas skabs thams cad du mis mi mthong ba'i phyir mi snang ba'i 'khor zhes grags la/ phyed lhag ma bdun brgya ni/ shing lham dang*/ gter gyi bum pa dang*/ ral gri dang*/ gnod sbyin mo la sogs pa dngos grub gzhan thob kyang mi snang ba ma bsgrubs pas/ lus dngos de nyid mi rnams kyis mthong ba'i phyir/ snang ba'i 'khor zhes bya/ 'di dag kyang 'dod na lus sbas pa'i mi snang ba ni yod do/ /rnal 'byor pho mo bdun cu rtsa gnyis su grags pa ni/ gnas chen thams cad du yid kyis bsams pa kho nas bgrod cing*/ slob dpon chen po nyid dang rig pa'i brtul zhugs lhan cig tu spyod pa'i grogs yin pa dang*/ slob dpon nyid dang rtogs pa mnyam par byin gyis brlabs so zhes grags so/ /stong bzhi brgya po rnams rtogs pa mnyam par ma nges kyang*/ slob dpon chen po skad cig gis yul chen rnams su 'byon pa na/

lhan cig tu rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro bar nus shing*/ rig pa'i brtul zhugs spyod pa'ang yin no/ /grong khyer bcu gsum gyi mi rnams rnal 'byor par gyur pa la/ rnal 'byor pa 'bum sde bcu gsum zhes grags te/ 'phags yul gyi sa phyogs thams cad nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i gsang sngags pa rnal 'byor pho mos khyab pa ltar gyur te/ rab kyis mchog 'grub pa dang*/ gzhan mang pos thun mong gi dngos grub mchog 'bring tha ma ci rigs pa 'grub pa dang*/ tha ma rnams kyis kyang ting nge 'dzin sna re ma thob pa dang*/ phra mo sna re ma grub pa med skad do/ /yang bshad pa/ spyir grub pa'i slob dpon rnams kyis bstan bcos mdzad pa ni/ do ha mgur du bzhes pa kho na mang*/ sgrub thabs che chung dang dbang chog dang*/ rdzogs rim gyi gzhung che ba'am/ chung ba mdzad pa'ang ci rigs pa yod pa der gda'/ 'grel ṭīka gi rigs sogs bshad chos mang po dang*/ dgag sgrub mang po'i rtsod chos dang*/ sgra sogs tha snyad kyi gtsug lag gi rigs ni/ grub thob dngos kyis gsungs pa cher mi 'byung la/ de 'dra'i rigs grub thob des mdzad do zer ba na/ slob dpon de dang de'i gsung rgyun nam bzhed srol bskyang ba'i phyir du phyis brtsams pa ste/ de dang de'i lugs yin pas lugs srol de slob dpon des mdzad ces pa'i don yin gyi/ dngos su ni paṇ+ḍi ta dag gis brtsams pa'o/ /des na grub thob kyi rtsom pa rnams dpe tshogs chen po'i rigs can nyung ngo*/ /slob dpon 'dis mdzad pa la he ru kas lung bstan pa/ gang las rnam pa drug gi ngag tshig dpyod gsal ba/ /zhes 'byung ba dang*/ sngar bod du grags pa ltar na/ gzhung drug rtsoms shig ces lung bstan pa'i gzhung drug gi ngos 'dzin la/ slob dpon ku sa la bha dra chung ba na re/ dang po bsam gtan gzhung yin te/ /ye shes kyi ni de bzhin gnyis/ /gsum pa rig pa'i brtul zhugs te/

/gzhan la gsang sngags sbyin byed pa/ / bzhi pa yin te gzhung gi rim/ /de bzhin rab 'byams rtog pa ni/ /blo ldan rnams kyis lnga bar bshad/ /gang yang dam pa'i don gsal ba/ /rnal ma'i sbyor ba drug pa ste/ slob dpon gyis ni de rab bstan/ /nyi shus lhag pa'i brgya phrag gi /rab tu sbyor ba bdag gis mthong*/ zhes 'chad de/ dang po bskyed rim/ gnyis pa dbang gi ye shes/ gsum pa spyod pa/ bzhi pa dbang chog lnga pa las tshogs/ drug pa rdzogs rim ste don sde tshan drug ston pa'i gzhung drug yin gyi/ spyi do ha phra mo sogs bstan bcos mtha' dag sdom pa la/ brgya dang nyi shu tsam khong rang gis gzigs gsung ngo*/ /yang 'phros don 'di go dgos te/ rdo rje'i glu bya ba dngos su rgyud las gsungs pa'i glu kho na la 'jog kyang grub thob yin nges rnams kyi nyams shar thol byung gi do ha rnams la'ang rjes mthun gyi dbang las rdo rje'i glu zhes zer bar snang ba'ang mi 'gal lo/ /yang jo bo nā ro pa rjes 'brang dang bcas pa ni/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa nyid kyi bkas gnang ba'i phyir 'khor lo sdom pa kho na'i dgongs 'grel drug yin mod/ 'on kyang cha shas phra mo tsam nas rtsi dgos pa ma yin pas gzhung gi gtso po drug go /de yang dbang chog dang*/ sgrub thabs dang*/ sbyin sreg dang*/ dpyid kyi thig le dang*/ rim pa bzhi pa dang*/ gsang ba'i de kho na nyid de drug go gsung ngo*/ /da lta bod na yod pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'di/ slob dpon chen po'i gsung dngos ma yin par/ mar do lo tsā ba bzhed pa ni de bzhin yin te/ sngon slob dpon gyis sbyin sreg gi cho ga zhig mdzad kyang*/ bar skabs su dpe nub pas phyis rjes 'brang gi slob dpon gzhan gyis de'i tshab tu rtsams pa'o/ /dper na slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes kyis kyang*/ lung dang mthun pa'i chos bcu bzhi mdzad/ de'i nang na dbang chog yod kyang kha che'i yul du khyer nas dpe nub pas/

de'i dod du mar me mdzad kyis bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa brtsams pa lta bu'o/ /yang paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra ni/ gzhung drug ces pa rdzogs rim gyi gzhung ste/ sdom pa bshad pa/ snying po bsdus pa/ phyag rgya thig le rnam kyang bgrangs nas/ sdoms drug gi tha snyad mdzad do/ /'on kyang gzhung phyi ma gsum po de slob dpon chen po 'dis mdzad pa min pas/ gzhung drug la bgrong pa mi 'thad mod/ nag po pa'i rjes 'brang gi chos skor ngo mtshar can ni yin te/ mdzad pa po yang slob dpon grub thob spyod chung ba nyid do/ /spyir slob dpon 'dis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos gzhan mang po yod pa ni bden no/ /yang sngar pham thing pa mal lo sogs nas brgyud pa'i lo rgyus la/ bhaṅga lar rgyal po rol ba'i zla ba 'dul bar byon pa'i skabs de'i sngon du/ yul dbus nas shar phyogs la 'byon pa'i lam ka rnams su/ rdo rje phag mo mdze mo'i rnam pa dang*/ shing thog bsrung ba'i bu mor sprul pa dang*/ dpal he ru ka thod mkhan dang*/ glog dar mkhan du sprul pas spyod pa'i dus ma yin zhes bzlog pa dang*/ bhaṅga la phebs nas rgyal blon gyis bris sku la zhag bdun mchod pa'i bar der/ slob dpon dur khrod du tshogs 'khor la byon pa na/ tirti ka ste mu stegs pa'i tshul mi sngon po thod pa 'dzin pa cig byung nas/ ngas tshogs dpon byed zer ba la khyod kyis mi rung byas pas/ de dpal he ru kar gyur nas nam mkha' la 'phags te/ mdze mo de yang mdze mo ma yin rdo rje phag mo'i rnam 'phrul te/ zhing rmod de yang zhing rmod ma yin he ru ka yi rnam sprul lo/ /bu mo de yang bu mo ma yin rdo rje phag mo'i rnam sprul lo/ /klog mkhan de yang klog mkhan ma yin he ru ka yi rnam 'phrul lo/ /thod pa can yang thod pa can min he ru ka yi sprul pa'o/ /tshe 'dir mchog min gzhung drug rtsoms shig bar dor mchog gi dngos grub thob/

/ces gsungs pa la/ slob dpon gyis/ khyod kyi zhabs gnyis mnyam par mnan na 'og gi klu yang 'jig 'gyur zhes te thugs rjes zhabs g.yon bskum par mdzad/ /dbu yi gtsug tor drang por bsrangs na tshangs pa'i 'jig rten 'jig 'gyur zhes te dbu ni cung zad yo bar gnas/ khyod kyi phyag rnams drang por bsrangs na phyogs skyong rnams kyang skrag 'gyur zhes te thugs rjes phyag rnams cung zad bskum/ /rje btsun khyod kyi sku yi gar ni dgos pa dang ldan mthong bas dad de mchog tu gus pas 'dud/ /ces bstod pas mi snang bar gyur/ ces zer bar snang*/ tshig bcad rting ma 'di rgya gar ba'i ngag sgros cig yin par 'dug bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs par byed pa'i tshig snga ma drug bo rnams bod tshig tu gsal/ sngar bshad mdze mo sogs kyis de bī ko ṭar bgrod pa las bzlog pa yin na mi 'gal mod kyang*/ brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa las bzlog pa ni mi bden te/ grub pa'i slob dpon mchog gi bkas gnang nas/ yi dam mam mkha' 'gros bzlog pa ni 'gal zhing*/ ci ste bzlog dgos kyang*/ spyod pa la ma zhugs pa'i sngon rol nas bzlog pa 'os kyi/ skabs der spyod pa spyad nas yun ring lon zin pa la bzlog kyang dgos pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /thod mkhan dang*/ klog mkhan dang*/ thod pa can rnams kyi lo rgyus 'di sgrub pa po gzhan la byung ba yin gyi/ slob dpon 'di'i lo rgyus min no/ /yang bshad pa/ spyir dngos grub chen po khyad par can brnyes pa'i grub thob rnams/ grub pa'i sa de brnyes phyin chad/ yi dam lhag pa'i lha thams cad 'grub pa yin la/ rgyud thams cad kyi dgongs pa'ang rtogs pa yin pas/ lha so so dang rgyud so so'i phyogs rigs su bcad pa mi 'byung bas/ slob dpon 'di yang lha dang rgyud kun gyi bdag po yin mod kyi/ sngon dngos grub ma thob pa'i dus/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa nyid kyi sgrub pa po yin cing*/

phyis dngos grub brnyes nas kyang bstan bcos mdzad pa grags che ba rnams/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i dgongs 'grel shas che bas 'di nyid rgyud de'i lugs la grub pa thob pa yin par thams cad 'dod pa mthun/ de'i steng du lhag chos la/ rgya gar ba'i dgyes rdor ba rnams dang*/ gsang 'dus pa rnams dang*/ gshin rje gshed nag po mkhan rnams kyang rgyud de dang de'i sgrub pa po yin no zhes/ slob dpon 'di la su thob kyi tshul du byed mod kyi/ don la de thams cad yin pas 'gal ba med de/ rgyud de dag gi chos rgyun la/ slob dpon 'di bzhugs pa'ang mang du yod cing*/ gzhan yang mahā mā ya'i dkyil chog rim pa gsal ba dang*/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i dkyil chog sa ra has mdzad par grags pa sogs kyang slob dpon 'di'i rjes 'brang gi gzhung yin par dngos su grub pas mtshon te mtha' yas par dag go /slob dpon 'di'i slob ma sangs rgyas kyis lung bstan pa dag gi dang po/ e ya la pa ni/ slob dpon chen po yul dza lan+dha ra nas spyod pa la mi 'byon tsam gyi dus shig rgyal po zhig gi glang po che skyong ba'i bu gcig rnal 'byor pa byas shing bsgoms pas/ mi ring bar lus shin tu yang ba thob ste/ zhabs sa la mi reg par gshegs so/ /phal cher bla ma'i phyag g.yog tu yod pa'i ngang nas rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mdzad de/ yang phyis sdom pa'i rgyud las bshad pa'i las kyi phyag rgya chen po grub ste/ de'i rtags su yul gyi bud med ngan ma mang po dag la ye shes phab cing bsgrubs pas thams cad gzugs dang skal ba mchog dang ldan cing 'bar snang can du song*/ de 'dra brgya nyi shus tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor yang byas/ yang yul a la ka na log lta'i rgyal po ma hu ba zer ba cig gi sar byon/ khyed kyi chos la yid ches ci yod zer/ khyod nyid gang 'dod byas pas/ gser la dga' zer/ slob dpon 'dis snod chen po gcig nam mkha' la bzed pas gser gyis gang*/

rgyal po de ya mtshan skyes nas chos la zhugs so/ /phyis slob dpon spyod pa ba taṃ ba la'i yul du bzhugs dus gcig phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob ste 'ja' lus su gyur to/ /'di ni dpyid kyi thig le kho na bsgoms pas grub pa thob pa'o/ /gnyis pa ma hi la pa ni/ yul ni ma la bar 'khrungs zer/ rigs dmangs rigs lus stobs shin tu che ba zhig yod de/ lag pa ya ris go yu dang*/ na ri ke la'i shing sdong rtsa ba nas 'byin nus zer/ der skye bo thams cad lus stobs kyis pham par byed pa cig yod pa las/ lan cig slob dpon spyod pa pa las zhig la phebs pa la/ lus stobs 'gran no byas nas 'ongs pa na slob dpon gyi phyag g.yon pa'i sor mo gcig reg pas/ khong gi lus stobs thams cad nyams te der 'gyel lo/ /de nas nga rgyal chag ste rnal 'byor pa byas/ kha zas nyung ngu'i dka' thub spyad de/ lo bcu gnyis 'khor lo sdom pa bsgoms pas mchog gi dngos grub nyams 'og tu chud/ yul sau raṣ+tar mu stegs kyi gnas cig na bram ze dang kun tu rgyu lnga brgya tsam yod pa la/ der byon nas slong mo byas pas de rnams kyis bzhad gad byed cing 'phya'o/ /der ni tra a bo li zhes pa ste gnyid shog cig pa lan mang du gsungs pas/ de rnams thams cad gnyid du song*/ zhag bdun gyi bar du ma sad do/ /der gzhan rnams kyis nus pa dkrol bar zhus pas/ phyag se gol gtog pas thams cad gnyis sad do/ /de nas ngo mtshar skyes nas de rnams slob dpon ma hi la'i zhabs la gtugs/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la zhugs shing*/ de dag gi nang nas dngos grub thob pa yang mang du byung ngo*/ /gsum pa dha ma pa ni/ yul mahā raṣ+ta ba/ dang po bram ze'i rigs mang du thos pa zhig yin/ de nas slob dpon gyi drung du byon bla mas kyang dbang bskur zhing rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ 'dis thog ma bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed zhal gzigs/

nus pa cung zad thob nas slob dpon spyod 'chang dbang po'i 'phral gyi rim gro pa mdzad/ bla ma phan tshun du gshegs shing bzhud pa na/ dha mā ma ste rnga zlum brdung ba po yun ring du mdzad pas dha ma par grags so/ /de nas yun ring zhig lon pa na/ lan cig bsgom zhing bzhugs pa'i dus/ rang gi mdun du thod pa dkar tser re ba cig byung*/ de phyag tu blangs pa na de'i nang na mi gtsang ba ljan ljin sna tshogs kyis gang ba 'dra ba zhig 'dug rnam rtog med par de gsol bas/ rtsig pa la thogs pa med pa dang*/ dpag tshad brgya phrag mang po yud tsam gyis bgrod nus pa byung*/ phyis phyag rgya chen po mchog 'grub bo/ /bzhi pa dhu ma pa ni/ yul skad du shar phyogs ra ra zer/ legs sbyar skad du ra dha'i yul te der 'khrungs/ rigs ni tshong dpon gyi bu yin/ gnas gzhi cig tu rab tu byung nas/ spyan ras gzigs kyi rnal 'byor ba zhig la dbang zhus nas bsgom zhing 'dug go /slob dpon spyod pa'i rdo rje 'khor bcas lam la 'byon pa mthong nas/ dad pa skyes nas phyi bzhin 'brangs so/ /lan cig slob dpon gyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal du phyin pas/ khyod kyis spyan ras gzigs bsgoms sam gsung*/ bsgoms zhus pas/ 'o na zhal blta bar 'dod dam gsung*/ 'dod zhus pas/ 'o na 'di la ltos zhes mdzub mos ston par mdzad de/ bltas pas nam mkhar 'phags pa lha lnga 'od lam me mthong*/ shin tu dga' bas bro 'khrabs/ zhag mang por ting nge 'dzin thun gcig la gnas pa byung*/ de sad tsa na rkang mgyogs kyi dngos grub thob skad/ 'di yang slob dpon chen po'i rim gro pa go re long byas te/ rnga pa ṭa ha brdung ba dang*/ 'bud dkrol gyi bya ba mang du mdzad pas/ rol mo'i sgra las brtags te mtshan dhu ma par grags/ 'di rdo rje bdag med ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms pas mchog thob pa yin yang zer/ gang ltar rgyud dgyes rdor la brten nas grub pa thob skad/

slob dpon chen pos rgyal po go bo tsan+d+ra btul ba'i dus de tsam nas gzung*/ dha ma dhu ma 'di gnyis kyis lo mang po zhig tu nye gnas rim 'gro pa kho na mdzad/ lan cig o rgyan dang nye ba'i yul chung zhig na/ lta ba log pa'i rgyal po skye ba snga phyi med par 'dod pa cig yod pa la/ khong gnyis rgyal po de'i drung du phyin pas/ de na re/ skye ba snga phyi med pa la khyed rnal 'byor pa byed pa 'khrul zer/ slob dpon gnyis na re/ skye ba snga ma yod de rgyal po khyed rang skye ba snga ma zhig gdol bar skyes pa'i dus/ rabs chad pas gser yod pa rnams ri 'di'i mtshan rtags 'di lta bur sbas 'dug pa/ de thon zhigade dus kyi skye ba dran 'ong gsung*/ des kyang de bzhin du byas pas skye ba dran/ rgyal po de chos la bcug go /thog mar dug sbrul dang*/ gcan gzan dang*/ choms po la sogs gdug pa can rnams rengs pa dang*/ dbang du byed pa la sogs pa'i lta stangs 'grub pa cig yin pa/ de nas phyis bhaṅga lar slob dpon chen pos rgyal po rol pa'i zla ba btul ba'i skabs shig na/ dha ma dhu ma gnyis ka 'ja' lus su gyur/ de yang thun mong tsam min mchog 'grub pa'o/ /yang phyis slob dpon chen po sku 'das dus/ de gnyis mngon sum du byung nas gdung ba'i glu dbyangs kyang blangs/ de rjes rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi mya ngan bsal ba yang byas/ skal ldan mang po la gdams ngag bstan pas/ rgyud grol ba yang mang du byung*/ mi rnams kyis mthong bar lo 'ga' bzhugs so/ /lnga pa bha dra pa ni/ slob ma kun gyi mchog tu gyur pa ste/ slob dpon nag po pa yul ka ling kar phebs pa'i dus/ yul de'i rgyal po'i bu gzhon nu ming bha dra zhes bya ba zhigaslob dpon 'khor bcas la lhag par dad de/ slob dpon gyi slob ma zhig dang 'grogs nas phyi bzhin du song*/ gru gzings la zhugs nas rnal 'byor pa mang po dang lhan cig sang gha lar song ngo*/

/gzhon nu des rig pa'i gnas thams cad ni sngar nas shes/ slob dpon gyi zhabs la gtugs te rjes su 'dzin par zhus pas skal ldan du mkhyen te dbang bskur zhing rjes su gdams/ dbang bskur ba tsam gyis ye shes dang ldan par gyur mod kyi/ phal cher bla ma'i drung du bzhugs shing*/ bla ma bsten pa'i sgo nas dka' ba spyod cing yun ring lon no/ /lan cig lam du song ba na/ mu stegs kyi rnal 'byor pa mang pos khyod slob dpon tsar+ya pa'i slob ma yin na nus pa yod dam zer/ kyal ka'i tshul du cung zad yod ces gsungs pas/ de rnams kyis rdo dang dbyug pa dang tho ba la sogs pa brgya stong bsnun pas sku lus dar bal gyi phung po 'dra ba bsgyur/ chu gri la sogs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnun tsa na rdo ngar ma dang thug pa bzhin du me stag khrom khrom pa byung*/ de ltar chu tshod gcig gnyis song ba na/ sngo tsam pe li zhes kyang zer/ me tog ma li ka'i sdong po cig phyag tu bsnams nas/ de rnams nyid la bsnun pas thams cad thang la ro bzhin du 'gyel te shi ba ltar song ngo*/ /zhag gcig lon pa gzhan rnams kyis gsol ba btab ste slar gsos so/ /dang por dbang bskur thob ma thag ye shes skyes kyang*/ 'di lta bu'i rtags ma bstan gyi bar du/ nus pa thob par sus kyang ma shes pas/ gu h+ya pa ste gsang ba pa zhes grags/ de'i go ba ni sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa'o/ /de nas mi ring ba na/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub nyam 'og tu chud pa yin/ 'on kyang re zhig bla ma bzhugs kyi bar/ mi snang bar gyur pa'i cho 'phrul ma bstan slob dpon spyod pa pa sku 'das nas/ slob ma rnams kyis sa phyogs der mchod rten dang lha khang zhig kyang bzhengs so/ /de dag gi bya ba yang mi phal ba bzhin du mdzad/ de nas bla ma'i sku tshe la bar du gcod par byed pa'i gdug pa'i mkha' 'gro ma de gang na 'dug ces 'tshol bar bzhud de/
