rdzu 'phrul gyis gnas chen gzhan thams cad dang*/ dur khrod thams cad du btsal yang ma rnyed do/ /de nas mngon shes kyis ring du brtags pas/ de bī ko ṭa'i gnas de nyid na/ si mi li zer ba'i shing zhig gi khong stong na srin 'bu la sogs lus gzhan sna tshogs su bsgyur nas yib cing sdod pa gzigs so/ /de nas ting nge 'dzin gyis sprul pa'i ral gris shing sdong de gshags te/ mkha' 'gro ma de'i co to nas bzung ste/ phyi mi mo'i lus kyi dbyibs de ral gris dum bur gtubs nas/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams la bza' bar sbyin/ sprul gzhi lha srin mo de ye shes sprul pa'i me 'od kyis bsregs te tshar bcad do/ /de nas rdo rje'i glu blangs shing*/ ched du brjod nas re zhig mi snang bar gyur to/ /slad kyi lo 'ga' lon pa na/ yul dza ṭa saṅgha ṭar byon/ de na rgyal po ardzu na dat+ta zer ba phyi ba cig yod/ des spyod pa pa'i slob ma mchog cig byung zer ba thos nas/ rgyang ring po nas bltas na/ sgra dang*/ 'od dang*/ sa g.yo ba dang*/ 'tshubs ma dang*/ me 'bar ba sogs kyi ban bun las ma mthong nye bar sleb pa na de'i gseb nas rnal 'byor pa cig byung ngo*/ /rgyal po ngo mtshar skyes/ mchod gnas mu stegs pa rnams kyis bkag kyang ma nyan par/ pho brang gi phyi rol tu song nas slob dpon gu h+ya pa'i zhabs la gtugs so/ /yun ring du mchod par byas shing*/ skabs shig 'jig rten pa'i lha khang zhig tu tshogs 'khor mdzad gsung tshogs rdzas bsnams te bzhud/ sgo bsdams te su yang mi gtong bar 'dug pa la/ lan cig sgo gseng cig byung*/ rgyal pos bltas pas/ rdo rje sems dpa' lha sum cu rtsa bdun du bzhengs par mthong skad/ der rgyal pos mthong ba dang mthun pa'i lha khang bzhengs par zhus pas/ de lta bu skal med kyi bltar mi rung bas/ bkaud pa de lta bu la chags bral gyi sku bzhengs na legs gsung*/

gtso bo bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shāka thub kyis mdzad pa'i lha khang cig bzhengs/ de la ming bud+dha s+thā pa na ste/ sangs rgyas gnas gzhi zer ba yin/ yul de na lha khang gzhan thams cad mu stegs pa'i yin pas de la sangs rgyas kyi gnas gzhir thogs pa'o/ /lha khang 'di'i ngo dod da lta yang yod/ yang lan cig kha che'i yul du tu ru ska ma na zhes bya bar/ rgyal po kla klor gyur pa cig gi dmag byung ste/ kha che'i yul mtha'i mi rnams thams cad bros/ rgyal po 'khor bcas kyis 'khrugs kyang thub par dka' ba la/ slob dpon 'di nye skor na bzhugs pa la gsol ba btab pas/ ri dwags ru ru'i rwa dung zhig la sngags kyis bzlas shing byin gyis brlabs nas/ rgyal po la gtad de/ phan tshun g.yul bshams pa'i tshe/ 'bud dkrol dang lhan cig 'di bus shig gsung de nas de bzhin byas pas/ kla klo'i dmag mi mang po ni brgyal zhing myos/ phal cher ni rna ba 'on/ rta thams cad sus kyang bzung mi thub par rgyug cing bros so/ /der kla klo'i dpung rmeg med par gyur/ kha che'i rgyal po'i dmag gis yul de yang mnan te chos dbu 'phang mtho bar mdzad do/ /de skabs kyi kha che'i rgyal po ni har+ṣa de ba yin par grags/ blon po'i bu shin tu rmongs pa blo zhan pa rdul ba zhig gis/ rwa dung de blangs te 'ga' rer bus pas skad cig de la skad dang bstan bcos mtha' dag shes pa cig byung ming la swā yam+bhu ra dza zer te/ phyis kha che'i yul gyi klog dang yi ge dang brda sprod phal cher de la thug pa yin/ smra ba ches mkhas pa cig byung bar snang*/ gzhan yang slob dpon 'dis yul der/ digs pa brgya tsam la byin rlabs mdzad pas mkhas par song bar grags/ yang lan cig dpal o rgyan gyi gnas su bzhugs te/ de'i tshe o rgyan dang nye ba'i byang phyogs shig tu/ sngon med pa'i mtsho gsar ba brdol/ klu gdugs pa can o rgyan pa rnams la gnod cing*/

chos la sdang ba zhig byung*/ des rgyud bskul nas/ ma kha pa'i chom po'i 'tshe ba yang yang yong ba zhig byung ba na/ slob dpon 'dis de 'dul bar dgongs nas/ 'khor 'ga' zhig dang bcas te mtsho dang nye bar bzhugs so/ /der thog lhung ba dang*/ lce 'bab pa ji tsam bstan kyang*/ slob dpon 'khor bcas la gnod pa med par ma zad/ phyag gis blangs nas zhal du gsol lo/ /char drag po mi bzad pa'i shwa brgal khru nyi shu'i dpangs tsam byung ngo*/ /'khor bcas de lta bu'i rba rlabs kyi steng du byon nas/ mtsho de'i steng du bzhugs so/ /der srog chags gdug pa can mi zad pa dpag tu med pa 'dus nas byung yang snang ba med pa la mnyam par bzhag pas/ la las ma mthong*/ la las mthong yang reg thogs med de/ 'ja' tshon bzhin du gyur pas ci byar yang ma byung ngo*/ /ji zhig ltar na/ slob dpon gyis dgongs pa brtad pas mtsho khol/ 'gram phyogs gcig gi sa sgangs rnams dral te/ chu rnams phyir pho bas ma kha ba'i rta ba mang po'ang khyer/ mtsho bskams shing*/ klu gdug pa can yang rdzu 'phrul nyams te grags pa med par gyur skad/ de nas lo lnga brgya tsam gyi bar du/ o rgyan du ma kha sogs yul gzhan gyi gnod pa ma byung skad/ de dag la sogs pa lo mang du 'gro ba'i don mdzad nas/ slar yang sku lus mi snang ste/ zung 'jug gi skus mkha' khyab tu bzhugs pa'o/ /slob dpon 'dis kyang 'khor lo sdom pa'i phyogs la bstan bcos ci rigs mdzad cing*/ dgyes rdor gyi dgongs 'brel yang cung zad mdzad do/ /spyir bde mchog 'khor lo'i grub brnyes su kun la grags so/ /drug pa dge tshul tshim bu pa ni/ ma gha dha'i rgyal rigs kyi bu cigan lan+dar dge tshul byas chos kyang legs par shes pa cig yin/ slob dpon spyod 'chang dbang po yul koṅka nar bzhugs pa'i skabs shigagrogs 'ga' zhig gis bskul nas gnas der song ste slob dpon dang mjal/

rjes su bzung bar zhus pas/ yang dag pa'i dbang bskur te/ gdams pa dang rjes su gdams pas skyong bzhin du lo bdun gyi bar du 'dug go /de nas nang cig sprin kha dog sna lnga pa dang*/ nyi ma'i 'od dang*/ char zim dang*/ 'ja' tshon thams cad tshogs pa cig 'dug nas/ de la lta zhing lhan cig skyes pa'i don bsgoms pas de rnams sgyu ma lta bur shar/ de'i rkyen gyis yang dag pa'i ye shes phyin ci ma log pa rgyud la skyes so/ /de nas lta stangs brgyad la sogs pa yang rim pas grub/ yang lan cig drod rtags dang*/ mig sman la sogs pa'i dngos grub sgyu mas sgyu ma bslu ba 'dis ci phan byas ste/ lhan cig skyes pa 'ba' zhig bsgom zhing*/ shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa spyod do/ /de nas dus phyi zhig na slob dpon spyod pa pa 'khor bcas shar phyogs la gshegs pa'i skabs/ chu bo gang gā'i 'gram gyi lam 'phrang dog po 'dzur sa med pa cig na mdze mo lus thams cad rnag khrag dang rma shus gang*/ sor mo rnams chad pa cig 'dug go /de na re khyed rnams kyis nga chu bo 'di las bsgral nas grong khyer zhig gi 'dabs su skyol zer yang gzhan rnams kyis len mkhan ma byung*/ der tshim bu pas rgyab tu khur te/ chu bo gang gā la rkyal zhing song*/ gāng ga'i dbus su sleb pa tsam na/ mdze mo de rdo rje phag mo'i sku'i rnam par dngos su gyur te/ tshim bu pa'ang bde mchog he ru ka'i rnam pa 'dzin par gyur pa/ rdo rje phag mos tshom bu pa'i phyag nas khrid de nam mkha' la 'phags so/ /der rnal 'byor pa gzhan rnams la/ rdo rje phag mo'i zhal nas/ rnal 'byor pa bya ba snying rje dang ldan pa dgos pa yin/ de med par dngos grub ga la thob gsung*/ tshul des tshim bu pa mkha' spyod du bzhud do/ /'di bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi le'u so bdun pa nas/ ha har rgod pa'i dngos grub tu bshad pa de yin par snang bas/

de dus dngos su thun mong gi dngos grub chen po yin yang*/ de nas mi ring par mchog dngos su 'grub pa'o/ /slob dpon 'di sngon dge tshul yin pas/ dge tshul tshom bu pa zer yang*/ phyis cha byed rnal 'byor pa ka yin par 'dug tshim bu'i go ba ni phyags dar khrod gyon pa'i ming yin/ kha cig mtshan dngos ma ṇi bha dra ste nor bu bzang po bya ba yin zer ro/ /slob dpon 'dis mdzad pa'i do ha'i rigs ni ci rigs pa yod/ gzhan des mdzad pa'i bstan bcos dang*/ chos rgyun gyi rigs ni cher ma byung ba 'dra zhing*/ rdzu 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa'i lo rgyus kyang*/ spyir mang du yod dgos kyang gzhan ma rnyed do/ /de ltar slob ma drug po de dag ni/ slob dpon chen po nyid dang lhan cig tu rig pa'i brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa spyad pas mchog thob pa'o/ /slob dpon chen po kah+na pa'i slob ma bud med grub pa thob pa la/ slob dpon chen po lho phyogs mahā raṣ+tar byon pa'i dus/ yul de na rgyal rigs kyi bu mo spun gnyis las che ba'i ming ni me kha la zhes bya/ chung ba'i ming ni ka na kha la'o/ /de gnyis lo bcu'am brgyad lon pa na/ bram ze'i khye'u gnyis dang gnyen du bsgrigs yod kyang*/ khye'u de gnyis ches gzhon pas lo 'gar bag ma la ma song ba na/ yul mi thams cad kyi de dag la kha zer bar byed do/ /de yang las kyi mthu yin gyi nyes pa ni med skad/ de nas mdun ma de dral lo/ /slob dpon 'khor bcas rdzu 'phrul rnam par 'phrul ba can mthong pas/ yid la ya mtshan cher skyes nas/ bdag cag 'khor bas 'jigs pa lags kyi/ 'khor ba las thar ba'i thabs cig 'tshal zhus pas/ snod dang ldan par mkhyen te dbang bskur bas ye shes mchog phebs/ gdams pa dang rjes su gdams pas bskyangs pa na/ mi ring bar lta stangs brgyad la sogs pa'i nus pa yang thob/ rtsig pa dang*/ ri dang*/ chu la thogs pa med/ mngon shes la sogs pa'i yon tan mang po thob bo/

/de nas kyang tshogs pa de nyid du gtso bor gnas shing*/ rig pa'i brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa can no/ /lan cig de gnyis lam du song ba na/ go rak+ṣa'i rjes 'brang rnal 'byor pa phal pa mang po lam na 'dug pa rnams kyis co 'dri zhing*/ nag po pa slob mar bcas pa sgyu ma ston par byed do zhes smra ba la/ dzo gir grags pa de rnams nyid kyi gnas gzhis phyogs yid du 'ong ba cig na 'dug pa las khang pa thams cad lta stangs kyis drangs nas ma zhig pa kho nar bye ma'i thang skya bo yid du mi 'ong pa la bzhag go khyed rnams kyang sgyu ma 'di lta bu gyis shig byas nas song ngo*/ /de nas dus gzhan zhig na de dag gis bzod pa gsol bas/ khang pa rnams sngar gyi gnas su bskyal lo/ /phyis slob dpon chen pos bhaṅga lar/ rgyal po rol pa'i zla ba btul ba'i dus skabs shig na skye bo mang po 'dus pa'i dbus shig tu de gnyis slob dpon gyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas bla ma'i drin gyis bdag cag gnyis kyis don chen po bla na med pa thob pa lags pas/ da ni mkha' spyod du 'gro na/ thog mar slob dpon gyis gang bka' stsol ba de bgyid zhus pas/ 'o na mgo bo bcad de nga la phul zhig gsung*/ der ye shes kyi ral gri rno ngar dang ldan pa re kha nas byung ste/ rang rang gi mgo bo thogs pa med par bcad de bla ma'i phyag tu phul nas/ phyi ltas su gar byed cing nam mkha'i lam las je mtho je mthor song nas 'ja' 'od du yal lo/ /sngon lha mo dpal gyi blo gros las kyang 'di dag dang 'dra pa'i cho 'phrul bstan 'dug /srin po dang mkha' 'gro ma phal pa'i gzugs la yang*/ 'di lta bu mang du yod pa yin 'dug /de'i gnyen por rdo rje phag mo dbu bcad ma sogs 'byung ba ltar/ rdo rje phag mo'i grub thob rnams kyi cho 'phrul la yang*/ 'di 'dra mang dag byung par gda' 'o/ /slob dpon nag po spyod pa'i slob ma bud med kyi rten can grub pa thob pa thams cad kyi mchog rnal 'byor ma ban+dhe pa'am/

sing gha gling gi rnal 'byor ma'am/ ḍom+bi rnal 'byor mar grags pa de ni/ gling khyad par du 'phags pa sing gha lar/ ḍoṃ pa zhes pa rigs ngan g.yung po'i rigs la bu mo zhig btsas pa ni pad+ma can mchog gi mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa zhig go /cher skyes pa na blo gsal zhing rig pa dang ldan pa dang tshul bzang ba zhig yod pas yi ge sogs rig pa kun yang byang ngo*/ /slob dpon spyod pa pa 'khor bcas gling der phebs nas mi ring ba zhig na/ de rnams kyis ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos mthong ste/ shin tu dad par gyur kyang*/ rigs kyi dbang gis chos spyod pa'i skal ba med snyam pa dang*/ 'di dag dang nye bar yang mi nus snyam tsa na/ rnal 'byor pa kha cig /'di na rigs dang rigs min med/ /'gro ba 'di dag thams cad la/ /rang byung ye shes yang dag gnas/ /de phyir kun la brnyas mi bya/ /zhes sogs glur len pa thos pas rang nyid chos kyi skal ba yod par shes nas/ mchog tu dga' ba skyes so/ /de nas lan cig slob dpon 'khor dang bcas pa mchod ston rgya chen pos tshims par byas nas/ yang dag pa'i lam stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas zhal gyis bzhes so/ /de nas dus gcig na slob dpon 'khor bcas dur khrod cig tu bzhugs pa'i sar/ phag gi sha gcig dang myos byed bum pa gang khyer te phul pas/ tshogs rdzas de kho nas rnal 'byor pho mo stong phrag mang po 'byung po dang thams cad tshims par mdzad de ḍom+bi ni la dbang bskur bas/ de nyid du ye shes mchog dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor ma chen mor gyur/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo de yang zhag bdun gyi bar du zad pa med par longs spyad do/ /de nas dpyid kyi thig le'i rnal 'byor 'bad pas bsgoms pas/ dus ji zhig ltar na/ nyin zhag bdun du sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba shin tu mi bzad pa'i nyams lus brgya stong du 'thor pa 'dra ba byung*/ des gtum mo 'bar ba'i me tshad rdzogs/

rtsa mdud thams cad zhig ste lhan cig skyes pa'i don ji bzhin du rtogs nas/ ting nge 'dzin thun gcig la zla ba drug 'das skad/ de sad tsa na grub pa'i dbang phyug mar gyur te/ yang dag pa lhan cig skyes pa'i don rtogs pas/ zhor byung gi yon tan gzugs bsgyur ba'i cho 'phrul dang*/ dpag tshad brgya stong du 'jug pa'i mngon shes dang*/ lta stangs la sogs pa'i nus pa dang*/ rkang mgyogs la sogs pa'i cho 'phrul rnams kyang rang shugs la thob bo/ /de nas yun ring po'i bar du slob dpon chen po'i 'khor gyi tshogs pa der bzhugs nas rtag tu tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor 'byung ba'i tshogs kyi gtso mo'i bya ba bsgrubs pas rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mdzad do/ /de nas phyi zhig na 'ja' lus brnyes shing bar skabs der mi snang par gyur pa las/ slob dpon spyod pa pa'i 'das mchod kyi dus mngon sum du byon te/ sa g.yo ba la sogs pa cho 'phrul du ma bstan de skabs yul ka ma rū par/ lha khyab 'jug chen po rta'i gdong can gyi rdo sku khru gang pa cig rang byung du byung*/ cho 'phrul shin tu che/ ha ri gi ri mā tho zhes grags shing*/ phyogs der de la mchod pa po bram ze cho 'phrul can sngags grub pa mang pos kyang bskor nas yod/ der sangs rgyas pa'i phyogs 'dzin pa rnams la/ 'bog nad gdong thug mang po dang*/ me lce 'bab pas gnas khang dang yo byad sreg pa sogs gnod pa mang du byung zhing*/ skye bo gzhan rnams la yang gnod pa cher byung ngo*/ /skabs der de byung nas lo mang ma lon pa'i skabs yin/ de 'dul bar rnal 'byor ma 'dis byon/ lam du cho 'phrul gyi rta ba mang po mtshon cha thogs te byung*/ yi dam gyi phyag mtshan gri gug cig yod pa de/ phyar ba tsam gyis de rnams thams cad sil bur zhig go /de nas lha khang de'i drung du byon pa na/ lha de khros pas phyi nang thams cad tu me 'bar bar bstan pas/

rnal 'byor mas de nyid du char chen po phab kyang zer/ sngags kyis btab kyang zer/ mi bskyod pas gtor yang zer/ gang ltar yang de ma thag me shi'o/ /de nas nang du byon pa na sku de nyid rta gdong khros pa mi bzad pa 'jigs pa'i cho 'phrul can du song nas/ za za 'cha' 'cha' ltar rgol du byung*/ bram ze sngags mkhan rnams kyang srin po mi gdug pa'i gzugs su bsgyur te/ mtshon cha sna tshogs dang*/ dbyug pa dang*/ rdo ba chen po dag brdeg tu byung ngo*/ /der rnal 'byor mas thugs g.yo ba med par thal mo brdabs pas/ khyab 'jug gi sku de'i sku gzugs ma de thal bar zhig rta mgo sa la lhung*/ bram ze rnams khrag tu skyug cing 'gyel lo/ /de dang nye ba na spyod pa khyab 'jug de nyid lhar 'dzin pa'i mi thams cad kyang myos shing rod rod bor song ngo*/ /de'i lha khang dang gnas gzhi thams cad kyang la la rtsa ba nas zhig /la la shag shig tu song ngo*/ /de ltar nyin zhag gnyis 'das pa na/ rgyal po la sogs pa skye bo rnams 'ongs te/ zhabs la gtugs nas gso bar zhus so/ /der bram ze la sogs pa'i skye bo rang rod du gyur pa rnams gsos so/ /de rjes rnal 'byor ma ban+dhe pa yul de'i u ma gi ri zer ba'i ri la bzhugs nas/ skal ldan rnams la chos cung zad ston no/ /de nas mu stegs de rnams kyis kho rang tsho'i gnas zhig pa rnams gsos/ ha ri gi ri mā tho'i sku 'dra bzhengs pa na/ bzhengs pa'i bya ba dang*/ zhal bsro byed pa la glang po che rgyugs pas thams cad bcom mo/ /yang bskyar nas bzhengs zin pa na/ khyim rdib ste zhig go /yang bzhengs zin pa na dum bur gas te rang zhig go /de nas rgyal po dang skye bo de dag dang bram ze de rnams kyang rnal 'byor ma'i drung du 'ongs te/ rin po che du mas sku la gtor zhing bzod par gsol nas sems can rang rang gi lugs 'dor bar mi nus pas/ thugs brtse bar mdzod ces lha khang bzhengs par gnang ba zhus/

phyis khong rnams kyis lha khang bzhengs pa na 'jigs pa ni ma byung*/ 'on kyang dus de nas gzung ste yul phyogs der lha khyab 'jug la mchod pa ni nyung ngo*/ /de rjes kyang yul sna tshogs su skal ldan 'ga' re smin cing grol ba la bkod de lo yang ci rigs par mi rnams kyis mthong bar bzhugs par grags so/ /'dis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos thor bu dang*/ do hā 'ga' re da lta'ang yod do/ /de dag ni slob dpon spyod pa pa nyid sku bzhugs pa'i skabs nyid du mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'i slob ma/ skyes pa'i rten can drug dang*/ bud med gsum ste shin tu grags che ba rnams yin no/ /gzhan slob dpon bha dā li pa ni/ shar phyogs bha ga lar 'khrungs pa/ slob dpon spyod pa pa yul dza lan+dha ra nas spyod pa la 'byon khar sleb zer/ phyis slob dpon sku 'das pa'i rjes su/ shar phyogs o ḍi bi shi'i yul du bzhugs/ der tshong dpon zhig gis dge 'dun la sa gzhi phul te/ gtsug lag khang zhig rtsig pa'i grabs byas pa na/ sa phyogs de dang po nas mu stegs rnams dbang zer nas/ nang pa'i gtsug lag khang bzheng du mi ster te/ slad kyis rgyal po la zhus nas/ bram ze zhig gis der mu stegs byed kyi lha khang ling ga can chung ngu zhig brtsigs so/ /yang slad kyis dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyis rtsod pa bslangs te/ phyi nang gi skye bo mang po der 'dus/ der slob dpon bha dā li byon te/ re zhig rtsod pa 'di ma zhi'i bar du lha khang 'di pha gir bskyal lags kyi byas/ lha khang de thag pas 'ching tshul byas rgyab khur du thogs nas/ bram ze de rnams nyid kyi grong gi 'dabs su bskyal lo/ /der grub pa'i rtags la ya mtshan skyes te/ sa phyogs der rang shugs kyis dge 'dun la byung nas/ aṃ k+ṣa s+thā pa na zhes bya ba'i gtsug khang brtsigs so/ /'dis kyang phyis phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub brnyes par grags so/

/grub thob la bā yi pa ni/ gong du smos pa ltar yang yin la/ phyis ma ga dhar rnal 'byor pa nus pa cung zad thob pa mang po 'dus nas/ dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal du tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrubs pa'i tshogs 'khor byed par byas/ slob dpon la bā yi pas tshogs kyi gtso bo byed par khas blangs so/ /der tshogs kyi khang par zhugs tsa na/ mu stegs can mdog nag po dbang phyug pa'i cha byad 'dzin pa/ u tsiṣ+ta pa ste gtsang sme med pa'i spyod pa can thod pa thogs pa cig byung nas tshogs dpon ngas byed zer ro/ /der slob dpon gyis khyed mu stegs pas nged sangs rgyas pa'i tshogs dpon mi rung byas pas/ 'o na khyod rang tshogs kyi gtso bo'i khri la 'dzegs zer/ khri'i dpangs khru do tsam yod pa de'i rtsar song na/ khri de mtho ru ma song*/ slob dpon gyi lus chung du ma song yang*/ slob dpon gyi lus kyis khri de'i bzhi cha tsam las ma sleb/ thabs gzhan gang gis kyang khri'i steng du 'gro bar ma nus so/ /de nas thod pa can de sprul pa'i sku yin par shes nas/ slob dpon la bā yi pas nyes pa bshags shing gsol ba btab pas/ de dpal he ru kar gyur te nam mkhar bzhugs nas/ khyod kyi dang po nyid nas nga rgyal spangs te gsol ba btab na da res ka 'dod pa'i dngos grub thob pa la nga rgyal gyis nyes/ da sems can gyi don gyis zer mi snang bar gyur/ de nas slob dpon 'dir grong khyer a dzo dh+ya ru byon/ de na lta ba log pa 'dzin pa'i rgyal po bi dz+nya p+ti zer ba zhig yod/ de 'dul ba la dgongs nas/ yul de'i phyogs gcig brag cig gi khong na/ phug pa khong stong cung zad yod pa la/ bu ga sor brgyad tsam gyi tshad can brag srab thug khru brgyad tsam yod pa la bu ga de dod pa cig yin/ de min sgo med pa'i brag gi khong seng der bzhugs/ rgyal po de'i blon po dang nang g.yog 'ga' zhig gis don 'dra spyod pa'i lam du der song tsa na/

phug pa'i sgo shin tu yangs pa dang*/ phug pa de yang shin tu che bar 'dug cing*/ zas nor sna tshogs pa'i dbus na rnal 'byor pa de 'dug par mthong ngo*/ /de dag gis rgyal po la bsnyad pas nang par rgyal po lings la 'gro ba'i tshul gyis der bltar 'ongs pa na/ slob dpon phyir byon te rgyal po chen po 'dir cis kyang 'byon par zhu gsung*/ der phug gi sgo yangs ba'i 'du shes kyis 'khor 'ga' dang bcas pa zhugs shing*/ bza' btung gya nom pa mang pos tshims par byas so/ /de nas rgyal blon gnyis 'dug g.yog de phyir song ba'i skabs shig slob dpon gyis cho 'phrul bsdus pas khong gnyis phug pa dog mo der chud/ phyi rol tu 'gro sa'i sgo med cing*/ bu ga phra mo de'i phyogs kyang brag shin tu 'thug par shes/ ya mtshan yang skyes la shin tu skrag go /de nas slob dpon gyis de gnyis sngar gyi lta ba log pa de spangs/ dge ba byed par dam 'cha' ru bcug nas brag gi bu ga chung ngu de nas ka gnod pa med par phyir bton no/ /rnam 'phrul de lta bu bstan pas rgyal po de chos la bkod pa'o/ /rgyal po rol ba'i zla ba dang*/ blon po dge ba'i mgon po'i gtam rgyud kyi 'phros ni/ rgyal blon gnyis kas nyin mo ni rgyal srid kyi bya ba chos bzhin du skyod/ mtshan thog thag ni rim pa gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa las/ lo 'ga' zhig 'das par gyur pa na/ blon po la dngos su tsan+d+ra li 'bar ba'i gsal snang byung*/ dang por khyim nye 'khor dang bcas pa rtsig pa sogs kyis sgrib thogs med cing*/ nyin mtshan kun tu mthong*/ de nas rim pas rgyang grags tsam dang*/ dpag tshad tsam dang*/ gau ra'i yul tsam yang mthong*/ mi ring bar mtha' med du 'phel lo/ /de bzhin du sgra skad thams cad kyang thos shing shes/ sngar ma thos pa'i bstan bcos thams cad kyang rang shes nas/ lan cig rgyal po'i drung du phyogs kyi rgyal po mang po'i 'phrin yig dus gcig tu 'dzom/

'phrin yig de dag yul so so'i paṇ+ḍi tas brtsams pa/ sdebs sbyor dang snyan ngag gis bcings pas go dka' zhing*/ skad rigs dang yig rigs tha dad pa dang*/ lta grub tha dad pa'i shis brjod mi 'dra ba du ma yod pas/ yig mkhan dang*/ mdun na 'don bram ze paṇ+ḍi ta mang po 'dus te dpyad kyang*/ shin tu go dka' bar gyur pa la/ blon pos de dag thams cad bkrol zhing don rgyas par bshad/ lan rnams kyang so so dang mthun par byas pas rgyal po dang 'khor rnams na re/ sngar khyod kyis 'di lta bu shes su mi bsha' pa la/ 'di ltar yod pa ci yin dris pas/ ngas na ning bar la bslabs pa yin zhes kha bsgyur ro/ /de nas mi ring ba zhig na nam phyed cig gnyid du song ba'i gnyid sad pa na/ bud med rgan mo ches mi sdugs pa/ mdze skyas thebs pa cig gshed nas langs nas/ mkhar ba la brten cing blon po'i mdun du 'ongs nas/ bkres so zhes zer ro/ /de bcom ldan 'das ma'i rnam 'phrul du shes nas/ tsham tshom med par phyag byas nas/ bza' btung 'bru bcud gya noms pa thams cad phul/ bdag rjes su gzung bar zhu zhus pas/ des phyag spyi bor bzhag cing byin gyis rlob rlob ltar mdzad nas/ blon po nyid kyi spyi bor thim pa snyam byed pa na mi snang bar gyur skad/ der gnas lugs kyang rjes su rtogs/ phra mo rnams dang*/ dngos grub sna tshogs nyams 'og tu chud pa'i grub thob tu gyur kyang*/ re zhig sbas te tha mal ba'i tshul gyis rgyal srid kyi bya ba byed cing*/ mi rnams kyi bsam pa dang skal ba shes pa'i sgo nas spyod do/ /lan cig rgyal po'i drung du yod pa la/ rang gi skyed mos tshal gyi lha khang na/ 'o ma dang zho dag yod pa la/ byi la 'ga' zhig gis bldag pa mthong nas/ yengs tshul gyis de skrod pa'i brda byas so/ /rgyal pos ci yin dris pas/ dus la bab par shes nas/ rang gi dngos grub thob tshul rnams bshad/ de nas blon po'i bya ba bor te rnal 'byor pa'i spyod pas bzhugs shing sems can gyi don mdzad/

mthar phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob par grags so/ /grub thob ku sha la nā tha 'dis/ do ha dang zab don gyi bstan bcos ci rigs par mdzad do/ /sngar gyi 'phros la der rgyal pos bsams pa/ grub pa'i slob dpon gyi gdams ngag thob nas yun de snyed lon yang*/ dngos grub ma thob pa nga brtson 'grus chung snyam ste/ rgyal srid kyi bya ba blon po dang mdun na 'don dag byed du bcug ste/ nyin mtshan kun tu 'bad pas bsgoms so/ /de nas lo gcig gam gnyis tsam song ba'i dus na/ nyin mo cig gtsug lag khang dang dge 'dun rnams mchod/ de'i mtshan mo gsangs te dur khrod la mchod par byon/ de na bud med kyi ro sha thams cad btogs pa'i keng rus ma 'thor ba zhig 'dug pa la mchod pa byas pas de langs so/ /de la bcom ldan 'das ma bzhugs par shes/ sngags kyis gsol ba btab pas/ keng rus kyi gzugs gar mdzad cing chos bstan/ skad cig de nyid la rgyal pos nyams rtogs phun sum tshogs pa yang brnyes/ las phra mo sna tshogs pa grub bo/ /de nas gzung keng rus ta ra ṇa'i gdams ngag byung pa yin zhes grags/ bar der blon po rnams dang bram zes khrims 'chol bas yul mi bde bar gyur pa la/ rgyal po nyid kyis sngags dang ting nge 'dzin gyis bskul nas yul khams bde bar spyod do/ /lan cig mu stegs pa'i rgyal phran bco lnga tsam gyi dmag gis mtha' bskor ba la/ rgyal pos sngags kyis bsngags pa'i me tog gtor bas/ pha rol po thams cad shes pa 'gyur te dbang du 'dus/ rgyal po'i zhabs la phyag byas so/ /bhang ga la pa la gnod pa mi byed par mna' bor/ dam bzhag mang po byas te song ngo*/ /mthar rgyal po des kyang mi snang ba'i rig pa 'dzin pa thob skad/ spyir rgyal blon 'di gnyis las blon po grub thob che bar byed do/ /gzhan yang rnal 'byor ma kang ka nā pa zhes bya ba rang gi lag gdub la sems zin pas de la brten nas gnas lugs kyi don mngon sum du gyur/

rnal 'byor pa dhu ma pa dang lhan cig tu rig pa'i brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mdzad/ 'phral phal cher du shing a mra'i ljon pa'i 'bras bu rnams dzam+bu'i shing la spo/ de'i 'bras bu ke la'i shing la spo ba sogs ljon shing rnams ky-i me tog 'bras bu lo ma dag phan tshun du spo ba'i rol rtsed kho na mdzad skad/ mthar 'di yang mi snang ba'i dngos grub 'grub bo/ /rnal 'byor ma dza la ha ri ni/ rje rigs kyi bu mo zhig lo gnyis sam gsum du tshogs can ma byas so/ /de nas dad pa rnyed nas sngags kyi sgor zhugs te/ slob dpon chen po'i dngos slob kyang yin/ slob dpon gu h+ya pa ring du bsten cing*/ gtum mo bsgoms pas grub pa thob/ lo mang du 'gro ba'i don mdzad de/ de dag gi skabs phal cher du kha zas kyi bya ba mdzad pa na/ rang gi mdun du thod pa re bzhag nas/ khyim gcig gam gnyis sam gsum sogs nas/ gong bu dgug pa'i sbyor ba byas te/ la la nas 'bras chan dang khur ba bkug la la nas chang bkug la la nas zhun mar sogs dgug ste snod khengs par mdzad de gsol lo/ /de'i skabs su yud cig khyim de dang de'i zas dang skom rnams bcud med par 'gyur/ /de nas khong rang tshims tshul mdzad nas se gol gtogs pa na/ slar yang khyim de dang der chang khugs pa dang*/ dar ba las mar skye ba sogs 'byung ngo*/ /'dis sna tshogs ri mo zhes bya ba'i gzhung zhig kyang mdzad de rdzogs rim ston/ 'di yang 'ja' lus su gyur par grags/ de dag la sogs pa dngos grub dang nus pa thob pa'i slob ma bgrang bar mi spyod do/ /yang nying slob rnams kyi rnam par thar pa ni spyir bri bar mi lang yang*/ slob dpon gu h+ya pa la slob ma grub pa thob pa mang du byung ba'i gtso bo lhag par grags che ba ni/ slob dpon an+tar pa ste an+tar tsar+ya zhes zer/ de nyid bod skad du bsgyur ba bar ma'i slob dpon no/ /mtshan dngos b-i dza ya rak+ṣi ta rnam rgyal srung ba ste/

de la zhes sbyar bas rnal rgyal zhabs zer ro/ /slob dpon 'di ni dpal nā lan dar/ rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas par byas shing*/ gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde yang mang du shes pa cig go /de nas slob dpon gu h+ya pa la dad pa rnyed nas/ de'i drung du rnal 'byor pa mdzad/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i don bsgom zhing bzhugs/ lan cig lam cig la bzhud pas/ grong khyer zhig gi mtha' na sngar gdol pa'i khyim zhig yod pa/ skabs der khang bzang rgya dpangs chen po yod pa cig tu song 'dug /de'i khang thog mda' yab kyi phag nas bud med bzang mo zhig rib tsam rib tsam blta zhing*/ yul o tre zhes pa na chang 'tshong ma nag mo zhes bya ba'i khyim na/ chos kyi glegs bam zhig 'dug pa khyod kyis long zhes zer ba gsan pas/ de ma thag chas nas rim gyis yul o trer byon no/ /de na chang 'tshong ma nag mo bya ba yod dam byas pas yod zer/ khyim rtsad bcad de der zhugs nas glegs bam yod med dris pas med zer/ khyim de yang chung ngu ngan pa cig la steng 'og kun tu btsal yang ma mthong ngo*/ /de nas de'i sgo drung du bzhugs te zhag shas shig song ba na/ nyin cig chang 'tshong ma te phyir song*/ rang nyid chang mang po 'thungs pas ra ro ste/ srang khar gnyid du song*/ ji zhig na de blo rdol gyi tshul du khro bo chen po sgo gong na yod zer/ der sgo steng brus te btsal bas gtum po khro bo chen po'i rgyud kyi glegs bam byung ngo*/ /de nyid sprul par shes nas gsol ba btab kyang*/ dngos su lan cang ma byung*/ rmi lam du lo bdun nas ston par 'gyur gsung ba byung bas/ glegs bam spyan drangs te ma ga dhar byon/ phyis lo bdun na rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma mngon sum du byon nas byin gyis brlabs shing rgyud de yang gzhan la ston pa'i snang ba stsal lo/ /de nas lan cig dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal du bsgoms pas he ru ka zhal gzigs shing*/

nus pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa chen por gyur to/ /de ltar rim pas bsgoms pas/ rgyud dang*/ sngags dang*/ ye shes kyi rim pa'i rtogs pa rdzogs/ 'khor mang po dang bcas nas bhang ga la dang*/ ma ga dhar phar 'gro tshur 'gro mdzad cing*/ spros bcas dang*/ spros med kyi rig pa'i brtul zhugs ci rigs pa mdzad pa na/ dus lan cig ma ga dhis yul gyi mtha' grong khyer kha ba tsa zer ba cig tu/ rgyal po'i blon po zhig gis lha khang bzhengs shing*/ de la rab gnas zhus pas zla ba nya ba zhig la rab gnas mdzad/ nyi ma de ka la nub phyogs sin+dhu'i yul du kla klo'i rgyal po btul pa yin/ sku lus kyi bkod pa gnyis dus gcig tu bstan pa'o/ /de yang sin+dhu'i yul du kla klo'i rgyal po zhig gsar du bzhugs/ yul de na dge slong lnga brgya tsam gnas pa'i gtsug lag khang nor bu sbas pa'i ming can zhig yod/ rgyal po des de 'joms par 'dod pa na der gnas pa'i dge slong phal cher ni bros/ nang par kla klo'i rgyal po de ring yong rgyu'i de'i nub mo khyim chung zhig na phyogs nas 'ongs pa'i rnal 'byor pa cig 'dug /nam phyed na der rol mo'i sgra byung bas/ der sdod mkhan btsun pa cig gis sgo gseng nas bltas pas/ bud med gzugs dang rnam 'gyur sna tshogs can mang po rnal 'byor pa de la mchod pa byed par mthong ngo*/ /de la khyed nus pa thob par 'dug pas ma rungs pa'i rgyal po 'dul bar zhu zhus pas/ ngas de 'dul ba'i skal ba med/ slob dpon an+tar pa spyan drangs kyi zer/ rgyal po sang nyin 'ong na des mi phan byas pas/ ngas da lta sleb 'ong zer/ de rkang mgyogs grub pa yin/ de nas nams langs pa nyid na slob dpon an+tar pa 'khor bcas der byung ngo*/ /de nas nyi ma shar ba na rgyal po glang po che la zhon 'khor dang bcas pa der 'ongs/ slob dpon gyis glang po che la lta stangs mdzad/ glang po che'i sna dang mche ba sa la lhung*/

glang po che'i 'brogs pas kla klo'i rgyal po yang sa la lhung*/ yang lta stangs mdzad pas rgyal po dang dmag mi dpa' bo thams cad lkugs shing rengs par gyur/ dpung gzhan rnams bros so/ /de nas dmag mi dpa' bo de rnams kyi nang nas/ phal cher gyis slob dpon grub pa thob par shes/ gus pa byas pas rengs pa las grol lo/ /yang lta stangs mdzad pas glang po'i sna dang mche ba 'byor/ rgyal po ni gso ba'i skal ba med gsung ste dus las 'das so/ /de nas mi ring bar rgyal po gshin rje zhes bya ba chos dang ldan pa cig gis rgyal srid de blangs so/ /slob dpon 'dis phal cher 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgo nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad/ grub thob til+li pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma yang 'di yin/ mthar shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa spyad pas gsang rim mthar phyin/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa'o/ /gzhan yang slob dpon nag po spyod pa chung ba dang*/ bhu ba ri pa dang*/ bhu pa blo ldan la sogs pa dang*/ ku sa la bha dra chung ba nas brtsams te/ da lta'i bar du yang tsar+ya pa'i sde ma stongs par yod do/ /de dag gi lo rgyus ci rigs pa ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ bla med bde bas srid gsum khyab mdzad pa/ /dngos grub mchog brnyes rnams kyi gtam 'di mtshar/ /rang bstod tsam gyi rdzu rlabs 'phreng ba la/ /rdaum brjid chen por rlom pa bzhad gad gnas/ /spyod pa'i rdo rje slob ma'i tshogs bcas pa'i/ /gtam rgyud yid ches rung ba 'dir bshad kyi/ /'di las bsod nams phung po ci thob pa/ /des ni he ru ka dpal gnas thob shog /slob dpon chen po spyod 'chang dbang po'i rnam par thar ba ngo mtshar snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ rang dang lhan cig spyod pa kun dga' dpal bzang gis yang yang bskul nas/ tā ra nā thas bar skabs su nges par brjod pa'o/ /rang lo nga brgyad pa la bris pa yin/

gcig zhus/ maṅga laṃ// //bdag gis dge ba gang bsags 'di yis ni/ /sems can thams cad bde zhing skyid pa dang*/ /gnas skabs mthar thug phan bde mchog spel ba'i/ /bla na med pa'i rgyu tshogs nyid gyur cig/ //
